source_text:
By doing this repeatedly, it becomes obvious that the middle color
plays the role of both mixture parents, presenting them
in reversed placement.
translated_text: 反复这样做，就会清楚地看到，中间色扮演着两种混合母色的角色，并以相反的位置呈现它们。

source_text:
Repeating this experience with other colors will show that
in a true middle mixture the mixture parents will appear
in equal amounts.
translated_text: 用其他颜色重复这一经验会表明，在真正的中间混合中，混合母色会以相等的量出现。

source_text:
In most cases, however, the larger amount of I of the 2 colors
reveals its predominance.
translated_text: 然而，在大多数情况下，两种颜色中I的较大量会显示出其主导性。

source_text:
Such exercises are exciting as well as revealing, particularly
when extended to different and opposing colors.
translated_text: 这类练习既令人兴奋，又富有启示性，尤其是当它们扩展到不同的和相对立的颜色时。

source_text:
These exercises remind us that the basic after-image presentation,
the simultaneous contrast, is the cause of all color deception.
translated_text: 这些练习提醒我们，基本的后像呈现，即同时对比，是一切颜色欺骗的原因。

source_text: Whereas the first measuring of middle mixtures led us
translated_text: 中间混合的第一次测量曾引导我们

source_text:
to space illusion through connecting and separating boundaries,
this direct reading of the mixture constituents leads us
to a new deception: an illusion of volume.
translated_text: 通过边界的连接与分离进入空间幻觉，而这种对混合组成成分的直接读取则引导我们进入一种新的欺骗：体积幻觉。

source_text:
It is an effect we have seen in the channelings of the Doric column
and is called a fluting effect. (See plate xv-2.)
translated_text: 这是一种我们在多立克柱凹槽中见过的效果，称为凹槽效果。（见图版xv-2。）

source_text:
Color juxtaposition-
harmony-quantity
translated_text:
色彩并置——
和谐——数量

source_text: XVI
translated_text: XVI

source_text: Harmony
translated_text: 和谐

source_text:
Color systems usually lead to the conclusion
that certain constellations within a system provide color harmony.
They indicate that this is mainly the aim and the end
of color combination, of color juxtaposition.
translated_text: 色彩体系通常会导向这样的结论：体系内部的某些组合提供了色彩和谐。它们表明，这主要是色彩组合、色彩并置的目标和终点。

source_text:
As harmony and harmonizing is also a concern of music, so
a parallelism of effect between tone combinations and color combinations
seems unavoidable and appropriate. Although
a comparison of composed colors with composed tones is very challenging,
it should be mentioned that, while it can be helpful,
translated_text: 由于和谐与使之和谐同样也是音乐所关注的，因此，音调组合与色彩组合之间在效果上的平行关系似乎既不可避免又恰当。尽管将组合的色彩与组合的音调相比较极具挑战性，但应当提到的是，虽然这种比较可能有所帮助，

source_text: it is often misleading.
translated_text: 它却常常具有误导性。

source_text:
This is because different basic conditions of these media result in
different behavior.
translated_text: 这是因为这些媒介的不同基本条件会导致不同的行为。

source_text: Tones appear placed and directed predominantly in time from before
translated_text: 音调主要表现为在时间中从之前被安置并被导向

source_text: to now to later.
translated_text: 从现在到以后。

source_text:
Their juxtaposition in a musical composition is perceived
within a prescribed sequence only. Vertically, so to say,
translated_text: 它们在一部音乐作品中的并置，只能在规定的序列中被感知。可以说，在纵向上，

source_text:
1 tone, or several simultaneously,
sound for a varying but restricted length of time.
Horizontally, the tones follow each other,
perhaps not in a straight line, but of necessity in a prescribed order
and only in 1 direction-forward.
Tones heard earlier fade, and those farther back disappear, vanish.
translated_text: 1 个音，或几个同时发出的音，会响起一段长短不一但受限制的时间。在横向上，音相继出现，也许并非沿着一条直线，但必然按规定的顺序，并且只能朝 1 个方向——向前。先前听到的音会淡去，更早的那些则消失、隐没。

source_text: We do not hear them backward.
translated_text: 我们不会倒着听见它们。

source_text:
Colors appear connected predominantly in space. Therefore,
as constellations they can be seen in any direction and
at any speed. And as they remain, we can return to them repeatedly
and in many ways.
translated_text: 色彩主要在空间中显得相互联结。因此，作为星丛，它们可以从任何方向、以任何速度被观看。而且由于它们仍然存在，我们可以反复地、以多种方式回到它们那里。

source_text:
This remaining and not remaining, or vanishing and not vanishing,
shows only 1 essential difference between the fields of tone
and color.
translated_text: 这种存留与不存留，或者说消失与不消失，只显示出音的领域与色彩的领域之间 1 个本质差异。

source_text: The accuracy of perception in one field is matched
translated_text: 一个领域中感知的准确性，与

source_text:
by the durability of retention in the other, demonstrating
a curious reversal in visual and auditory memory.
translated_text: 另一个领域中保留的持久性相匹配，显示出视觉记忆与听觉记忆之间一种奇特的反转。

source_text:
Tone juxtapositions can be defined by their acoustical relationship
and thus measured precisely by wave length.
translated_text: 音的并置可以由其声学关系来界定，因此也可以通过波长来精确测量。

source_text:
Consequently, a graphic registration of tones in musical composition
has been developed.
translated_text: 因此，音乐作品中音的图形记录法已经发展出来。

source_text:
Color, also, can be measured, at least to some extent,
and particularly so when it is presented as direct color-
as the physicist registers it, by optical wave length.
translated_text: 色彩也可以被测量，至少在某种程度上可以，尤其当它作为直接色彩呈现时——正如物理学家通过光学波长来记录它那样。

source_text:
Reflected color, however, coming from paint and pigment
-our main medium-is much more difficult to define.
translated_text: 然而，来自颜料和色料的反射色——我们的主要媒介——要难界定得多。

source_text:
When analyzed with an electrical spectrograph
reflected color shows that it contains all visible wave lengths.
Therefore, any reflected color-not just white -
consists of all other colors.
translated_text: 当用电子光谱仪分析时，反射色显示出它包含所有可见波长。因此，任何反射色——不只是白色——都由所有其他颜色组成。

source_text:
This many-sided relationship between colors is clearly visible
in the plates of a 4-color reproduction, when singly shown,
because each of the 4 plates, although presenting only 1 color,
shows a complete picture.
translated_text: 色彩之间这种多方面的关系，在 4 色复制的色版单独展示时清晰可见，因为 4 个色版中的每一个，虽然只呈现 1 种颜色，却显示出一幅完整的图像。

source_text:
Color, when practically applied, not only appears in uncountable
shades and tints, but is additionally characterized
by shape and size, by recurrence and placement, and so on, of which
particularly shape and size are not directly applicable
to tones.
translated_text: 色彩在实际应用时，不仅呈现为无数的深浅和色调，而且还由形状和大小、重复和位置等等来进一步表征，其中尤以形状和大小不能直接适用于音。

source_text:
All this may signify why any color composition naturally defies
such diagrammatic registration as notation in music
and choreography in dance.
translated_text: 所有这些或许说明，为什么任何色彩构成都天然抗拒像音乐中的记谱法和舞蹈中的舞谱那样的图解式记录。

source_text:
With regard to constellation, tone intervals, such as third, fifth, and octave,
differentiate exact vertical distance. We say "vertical" probably because
tones are described as low and high.
Slide deflections (aberrations), such as in flat and sharp,
remain equally precise.
Color terms which could be considered parallel to tone intervals
are complementaries, split complementaries, triads, tetrads, and octads.
Though these characterize distance and constellation within color systems,
their deflections, such as incomplete triads and incomplete tetrads,
indicate that their measure is only arbitrary.
translated_text: 就星丛而言，三度、五度和八度等音程区分出精确的垂直距离。我们说“垂直”，大概是因为音被描述为低和高。滑音偏移（偏差），如降音和升音中的情形，仍然同样精确。可被视为与音程平行的色彩术语有互补色、分裂互补色、三色组、四色组和八色组。虽然这些术语表征了色彩系统内部的距离和星丛，但它们的偏移，如不完整三色组和不完整四色组，表明其度量只是任意的。

source_text:
Significantly, complementaries, though they are the basic color contrast
or interval, are topographically quite vague.
translated_text: 值得注意的是，互补色虽是基本的色彩对比或间隔，但在拓扑上却相当含糊。

source_text: In principle, a complementary is a color accompanied by its after-image.
translated_text: 原则上，互补色是一种伴随着其后像的颜色。

source_text:
However, the complement of a specific color, when placed
in different systems, will look different.
translated_text: 然而，某一特定颜色的互补色，置于不同系统中时，看起来会有所不同。

source_text:
Similarly, a triad or tetrad of one system will hardly fit
into another system.
translated_text: 同样，一个系统中的三色组或四色组，也很难适合另一个系统。

source_text:
Usually, illustrations of harmonic color constellations which derive
from authoritative systems look pleasant, beautiful, and thus convincing.
But it should not be overlooked that they are usually presented in a
most theoretical and least practicable manner, because normally
all harmony members appear in the same quantity and the same shape,
as well as in the same number (just once) and sometimes even in similar
light intensity.
Such outer equalization may unify them, but at the expense
of the more important inner relatedness-namely, as color only.
translated_text: 通常，源自权威系统的和谐色彩星丛图示，看起来令人愉悦、美丽，因而具有说服力。但不应忽视的是，它们通常以最理论化、最不实用的方式呈现，因为通常所有和谐成员都以相同的数量和相同的形状出现，也以相同的次数（仅一次）出现，有时甚至还具有相近的光强度。这样的外在均等化或许能使它们统一，但代价是牺牲了更重要的内在关联性——即仅作为色彩的关联性。

source_text:
When applied in practice, these harmony sets appear changed.
In addition to quantity, form, and recurrence,
wider aspects exert still more changing influences.
These are:
translated_text:
在实践中应用时，这些和谐组合显得发生了变化。
除了数量、形式和重复之外，
更广泛的方面还会施加更多改变性的影响。
这些方面是：

变化的和正在变化的光线——更糟的是，
几种同时存在的光线；
光与色的反射；
观看读取的方向与顺序；
以不同材料呈现；
相关物体与无关物体之间恒定的或变化的并置。

source_text:
With these and other visual displacements, it should not be a surprise
that the sympathetic effect of the original "ideal" color combination
often appears changed, lost, and reversed.
translated_text:
有了这些以及其他视觉位移，
原本“理想”的色彩组合所产生的协调效应
常常显得被改变、丧失，甚至反转，就不应令人惊讶了。

source_text:
Observe the interior and exterior, the furniture and textile decoration
following such color schemes, as well as commercialized color "suggestions"
for innumerable do-it-yourselves.
translated_text:
请观察按照这类配色方案布置的室内与室外、家具与纺织装饰，
以及为无数自己动手者商业化推出的色彩“建议”。

source_text:
Our conclusion: we may forget for a while those rules of thumb
of complementaries, whether complete or "split," and of triads and
tetrads as well.
They are worn out.
translated_text:
我们的结论是：我们不妨暂时忘掉那些关于互补色的经验法则，
无论是完整互补还是“分裂”互补，也忘掉三色组和
四色组的法则。
它们已经陈旧不堪。

source_text:
Second, no mechanical color system is flexible enough
to precalculate the manifold changing factors, as named before,
in a single prescribed recipe.
translated_text:
第二，没有任何机械性的色彩体系足够灵活，
能够把前面提到的那些多样而变化的因素
预先计算进一个单一的规定配方之中。

source_text:
Good painting, good coloring, is comparable to good cooking.
Even a good cooking recipe demands tasting and repeated tasting
while it is being followed.
And the best tasting still depends on a cook with taste.
translated_text:
好的绘画、好的着色，可以同好的烹饪相比。
即便是一份好的烹饪食谱，在执行过程中也要求品尝，
并且反复品尝。
而最佳的品尝仍然取决于一位有品味的厨师。

source_text:
By giving up preference for harmony,
we accept dissonance to be as desirable as consonance.
translated_text:
放弃对和谐的偏好，
我们便承认不协和与协和一样值得追求。

source_text:
In searching for new color organization-color design-
we have come to think that quantity, intensity, or weight, as principles of study,
can lead similarly to illusions, to new relationships, to different measurements,
to other systems, as do transparence, space, and intersection.
translated_text:
在寻找新的色彩组织——色彩设计——时，
我们逐渐认为，数量、强度或重量作为研究原则，
能够像透明、空间和交叠一样，
同样引向错觉，引向新的关系，引向不同的衡量，
引向其他体系。

source_text:
Besides a balance through color harmony, which is comparable
to symmetry, there is equilibrium possible between
color tensions, related to a more dynamic asymmetry.
translated_text:
除了通过色彩和谐而达到的平衡——这种平衡可比于
对称——之外，色彩张力之间也可能存在均衡，
它关联于一种更具动态性的非对称。

source_text:
Again: knowledge and its application is not our aim;
instead, it is flexible imagination, discovery, invention-taste.
translated_text:
再说一次：知识及其应用并不是我们的目标；
相反，我们的目标是灵活的想象、发现、发明——品味。

source_text: With this study of color effects, that is, of color deception,
translated_text: 通过这项关于色彩效果，也就是关于色彩欺骗的研究，

source_text:
a special interest in quantity-amount as well as recurrence-
has developed.
translated_text:
一种对数量——量额以及重复——的特殊兴趣
发展起来了。

source_text: Quantity
translated_text: 数量

source_text:
Although quantity and quality often are considered disparate, in art and
music they appear closely related. We may even hear, "Quantity
is a quality," because here quantity not only designates amounts,
as of weight or number, but also is a means of underlining,
of pronouncement, and a means of equilibrium, of balance.
translated_text:
尽管数量与质量常被认为彼此迥异，但在艺术和
音乐中，它们显得关系密切。我们甚至可能听到“数量
就是一种质量”，因为在这里，数量不仅指示量额，
如重量或数目的量，而且还是一种强调的手段、
一种宣示的手段，以及一种均衡、平衡的手段。

source_text:
One who particularly recognized the latter was Schopenhauer.
When he tried to improve Goethe's 6-part color circle-to Goethe's dismay-
he changed the previous presentation of 6 equal areas to decidedly
different quantities.
translated_text:
特别认识到后者的人是叔本华。
当他试图改进歌德的六分色环时——令歌德沮丧的是——
他把先前六个等面积区域的呈现方式，改成了明显
不同的数量。

source_text:
Thus yellow, the lightest color, appears in the smaller amount,
and its opposite, violet, as the darkest, in the largest amount.
He first allotted 3 equal thirds of a color ring to the 3 pairs
of opposites-yellow & violet-blue & orange-red & green.
Second, he subdivided those thirds, for the same order of pairs,
in¼+ ¾-1/.1 + %-½+½.These figures
in fractions of 12ths (relatively 36ths) are proportionate to
3: 9-4: 8-6: 6 equal parts.
When seen in a color circle, from yellow around to green, they present
translated_text:
于是，黄色，最明亮的颜色，以较小的量出现，
而它的对立色紫色，作为最暗的颜色，则以最大的量出现。
他首先把一个色环的三个相等的三分之一分配给三对
对立色——黄与紫、蓝与橙、红与绿。
其次，他又按同一对立色次序，将那些三分之一细分为
¼+¾-1/.1+%-½+½。【原文不清】这些数字
以十二分之一（相对而言为三十六分之一）的分数表示，与
3:9-4:8-6:6 个相等部分成比例。
在色环中观看时，从黄色绕行到绿色，它们呈现

source_text: the following quantities: 3 : 4 : 6 : g : 8 : 6.

The 2 basic quantity questions, how much and how often,
distinguish 2 kinds of quantity:
translated_text:
两个基本的数量问题，即多少与多频繁，
区分出两种数量：

source_text:
1 of size-extension in area-and
1 of recurrence-extension in number.
Both measurements concern predominance and emphasis.
They establish weight in space-and weight in time.
translated_text:
一种是大小——面积上的延展——
另一种是重复——数目上的延展。
两种衡量都关乎优势与强调。
它们确立空间中的重量——以及时间中的重量。

source_text:
Such considerations are both the source and result of our quantity studies
in which 4 colors usually appear in 4 different juxtapositions,
so different that all 4 studies appear as unrelated as possible.
translated_text:
这类思考既是我们数量研究的来源，也是其结果；
在这些研究中，四种颜色通常出现在四种不同的并置关系中，
其差异之大，使四项研究全都显得尽可能彼此无关。

source_text:
And thus they present changes in climate or temperature,
in tempo or rhythm-that is, changes of atmosphere or mood,
so that the factual contents (the same 4 colors) are hidden or, better,
hardly recognizable.
translated_text:
因此，它们呈现出气候或温度的变化，
速度或节奏的变化——也就是气氛或情绪的变化，
以至于事实内容（同样的四种颜色）被隐藏起来，或者更确切地说，
几乎难以辨认。

source_text: To use a theatrical parallel:
translated_text: 借用一个戏剧类比：

source_text: A set of 4 colors is to be considered-singly as "actors,"
translated_text: 一组 4 种颜色，单独看应被视为“演员”，

source_text:
together as "cast." They are to be presented in 4 different
arrangements-as "performances."
translated_text: 合在一起则是“演员阵容”。它们要以 4 种不同的编排呈现，即作为“演出”。

source_text:
Although they remain unchanged in hue and light, in "character,"
and appear in an unchanging outer frame, the "stage,"
they are to produce 4 different "scenes" or "plays,"
each to be so different that one and the same set of colors will be seen as
4 different sets, presented by 4 different casts.
translated_text: 尽管它们在色相和明度上，在“角色”上保持不变，并且出现在一个不变的外部框架，即“舞台”之中，它们却要产生 4 个不同的“场景”或“剧目”，每一个都要如此不同，以至于同一组颜色会被看作 4 组不同的颜色，由 4 套不同的演员阵容呈现。

source_text:
And all this can be achieved mainly through changes in quantity
which result in shifts of dominance, of recurrence, and consequently
of placement.
translated_text: 而这一切主要可以通过数量的变化来实现，这些变化导致主导性、重复性，并由此导致位置的转换。

source_text:
The essential question: which group of colors is ready to lose
its identity as a cast?
translated_text: 关键问题是：哪一组颜色准备失去其作为演员阵容的身份？

source_text: A parallel question: which distribution of appearance
translated_text: 一个平行的问题是：哪一种外观的分布

source_text:
( quantities of space, time, and weight) protects, disguises
recognition of the same color cast?
translated_text: （空间、时间和重量的数量）保护、掩饰了对同一颜色阵容的识别？

source_text:
Such quantity studies have taught us to believe that, independent
of harmony rules, any color "goes" or "works" with any other color,
presupposing that their quantities are appropriate.
We feel fortunate that so far there are no comprehensive rules
for such aims. (See plates xv1-2 and xv1-3.)
translated_text: 这样的数量研究使我们相信，独立于和谐规则之外，任何颜色都可以与任何其他颜色“相配”或“起作用”，前提是它们的数量恰当。我们感到庆幸的是，迄今尚无针对这类目标的全面规则。（见图版 xv1-2 和 xv1-3。）

source_text:
Here we may point to a discovery made by a few contemporary painters,
that the increase in amount of a color-not merely in size of canvas-
visually reduces distance. As a consequence, it often produces nearness-
meaning intimacy-and respect.
translated_text: 在这里，我们可以指出几位当代画家的一项发现：一种颜色数量的增加——并不仅仅是画布尺寸的增加——会在视觉上缩短距离。因此，它常常产生接近感——意味着亲密——以及敬意。

source_text: Film color and volume color-
translated_text: 膜色与体积色——

source_text: 2 natural effects
translated_text: 2 种自然效果

source_text: XVII
translated_text: XVII

source_text:
Usually, we think of an apple as being red.
This is not the same red as that of a cherry or tomato.
A lemon is yellow and an orange is like its name.
Bricks vary from beige to yellow to orange,
and from ochre to brown to deep violet.
translated_text: 通常，我们认为苹果是红色的。这种红不同于樱桃或番茄的红。柠檬是黄色的，而橙子的颜色正如其名。砖的颜色从米色到黄色再到橙色不等，也从赭色到棕色再到深紫色不等。

source_text:
Foliage appears in innumerable shades of green.
In all these cases the colors named are surface colors.
translated_text: 叶簇呈现出无数深浅不同的绿色。在所有这些情形中，所命名的颜色都是表面色。

source_text:
In a very different way, distant mountains appear uniformly blue,
no matter whether covered
with green trees or consisting of earth and rocks.
The sun is glaring white in daytime, but is full red at sunset.
The white ceilings of houses surrounded by lawns or the white-painted
eaves of a roof on a sunny day appear in bright green, which is
reflected from the grass on the ground.
All these cases present film colors.
translated_text: 以非常不同的方式，远处的山脉显得一律为蓝色，无论其上覆盖着绿色树木，还是由泥土和岩石构成。白天的太阳是耀眼的白色，但在日落时却是饱满的红色。在晴天，被草坪环绕的房屋白色天花板，或屋顶上涂成白色的檐口，会呈现出明亮的绿色，这是由地面草地反射而来的。所有这些情形都呈现出膜色。

source_text:
They appear as a thin, transparent, translucent layer between the eye
and an object, independent of the object's surface color. (See plate xv11-1.)
translated_text: 它们表现为介于眼睛与物体之间的一层薄薄的、透明的、半透明的层，独立于物体的表面色。（见图版 xv11-1。）

source_text:
For a very different color effect compare the coffee in a cup with the
coffee in the stem of a percolator or with the coffee in a silex glass.
It is easy to discover that, though all 3 containers hold the same
translated_text: 要比较一种非常不同的颜色效果，可以将杯中的咖啡与渗滤式咖啡壶管柄中的咖啡，或与 silex 玻璃壶中的咖啡相比较。很容易发现，尽管 3 个容器盛的是同样的

source_text:
coffee, the containers show this coffee in 3 different browns:
lightest in the stem, darker in the cup, darkest in the silex glass.
translated_text: 咖啡，这些容器却使这种咖啡呈现出 3 种不同的棕色：管柄中最浅，杯中较深，silex 玻璃壶中最深。

source_text:
In the same way, tea will look lighter in a spoon than in a cup.
Here we are dealing with volume color,
which exists and is perceived in 3-dimensional fluids.
translated_text: 同样，茶在勺中看起来会比在杯中更浅。这里我们处理的是体积色，它存在于并被感知于三维液体之中。

source_text:
The water of a swimming pool with blue walls will look dyed with blue
because of diffused reflection. Observing the white or blue steps
within the water, we will discover that with each step down
the blue of the water increases progressively, which presents a true
volume color effect.
In Chapter xx it will be explained in what proportion the blue increases.
translated_text: 蓝色池壁的游泳池中的水，由于漫反射，看起来会像被染上了蓝色。观察水中的白色或蓝色台阶时，我们会发现，每向下一阶，水的蓝色就逐步增强，这呈现出真正的体积色效果。在第 xx 章中将说明蓝色以何种比例增强。

source_text:
On the other hand, milk remains more or less the same white,
no matter whether seen in a small or large container.
Ink and oil paint behave in a similar way.
This demonstrates that only transparent fluids present volume color.
translated_text: 另一方面，无论是在小容器还是大容器中看到，牛奶都或多或少保持同样的白色。墨水和油画颜料也有类似的表现。这表明，只有透明液体才呈现体积色。

source_text:
In practice, most water colors are volume colors; several layers
on top of each other increase the darkness, weight, and intensity of a color.
Many aquarelles by Paul Klee demonstrate this.
The reverse effect of increased lightness is seen in fingerpaintings.
translated_text: 在实践中，大多数水彩都是体积色；几层叠加会增加一种颜色的深暗度、重量和强度。保罗·克利的许多水彩画都说明了这一点。相反的、明度增加的效果可见于手指画。

source_text:
In contrast to water colors, such media as oil paint, gouache, and pastel
produce surface color. In most cases these paints do not change
to any extent when applied in several layers.
translated_text: 与水彩相反，油画颜料、树胶水粉和粉彩等媒介产生的是表面色。在大多数情况下，这些颜料在涂覆数层时并不会发生多大变化。

source_text:
A new medium with volume color effect is a photosensitive glass
developed by Corning Glass Works. With increased exposure
to certain rays, the translucent opalescent white within the glass increases.
This results in a darkening of the whites with light passing through,
but in a whiter white in reflected light.
translated_text: 一种具有体积色效果的新媒介，是康宁玻璃公司开发的一种感光玻璃。随着对某些射线曝光的增加，玻璃内部半透明的乳白色会增强。这导致在透射光下白色变暗，而在反射光下则呈现更白的白色。

source_text:
A similar effect can be achieved in tracing paper. By looking
through several layers against the light, the paper becomes darker.
However, the same layers seen from the direction of the light will appear whiter.
Since film color is not the result of physiological or psychological transformation,
it is a physical phenomenon.
Both film color and volume color might be considered tricks of nature.
translated_text: 在描图纸中也能达到类似效果。若对着光透过几层纸观看，纸会变得更暗。然而，从光线方向看同样的几层纸，则会显得更白。由于膜色不是生理或心理转化的结果，它是一种物理现象。膜色和体积色都可以被视为自然的戏法。

source_text:
Free studies-
a challenge to imagination
translated_text:
自由习作——
对想象力的挑战

source_text: XVIII
translated_text: XVIII

source_text:
The previous chapters deal mostly with tasks to be solved as
class problems. Through them, all class members work in 1
direction only. This means they compete for the solution of
translated_text: 前几章主要处理的是作为课堂问题来解决的课题。通过这些课题，全班成员只朝一个方向工作。这意味着他们是在为解决

source_text: 1 given problem at a time-that of a single color effect.
translated_text: 一次给定的一个问题——即一种单一的色彩效果——而竞争。

source_text:
Although the solutions may differ considerably, and especially so
in their presentation, the work of the whole class appears unified.
translated_text: 尽管解决方案可能大相径庭，尤其是在呈现方式上，但全班的作品看起来是统一的。

source_text:
Such studies aim at the development of observation, of differentiation.
And this is particularly so through an inevitable constant comparison
going on from student to student. As a consequence, these studies
permit hardly any self-expression.
translated_text: 这类习作旨在发展观察能力和辨别能力。尤其是通过学生与学生之间不可避免地持续进行的比较来实现。因此，这些习作几乎不允许任何自我表现。

source_text:
Thus, after such systematic exercises, a need for independent work arises,
and free studies are encouraged. With them one may play with colors
as one pleases, independent of exercises, independent of teachers
and of other students.
translated_text: 因此，在这样的系统练习之后，便会产生独立工作的需要，于是自由习作受到鼓励。通过自由习作，人们可以按自己的意愿玩味色彩，不受练习约束，不受教师和其他学生约束。

source_text:
Whereas the systematic problems occupy most of the class time and
are finished afterward, the free studies are mostly homework, although
translated_text: 系统问题占据了大部分课堂时间，并在课后完成；而自由习作大多是家庭作业，尽管

source_text:
they accompany the systematic studies almost from the beginning
through the whole course.
translated_text: 它们几乎从一开始就伴随着系统习作，贯穿整个课程。

source_text:
The measure for evaluation of free studies is color relatedness.
This means color juxtaposition in which color exists for color's sake,
and therefore appears autonomous, and not merely as accompaniment
to form, to shape. (See plates xvu1-3 and xv111-9.)
translated_text: 评价自由习作的尺度是色彩关联性。这意味着色彩并置，其中色彩为色彩自身而存在，因而显得自主，而不只是作为形、形状的伴随物。（见图版 xvu1-3 和 xv111-9。）

source_text:
Whether something "has color" or not is as hard to define verbally as are
such questions as "what is music" or "what is musical."
translated_text: 某物是否“有色彩”，就像“什么是音乐”或“什么是音乐性的”这类问题一样，很难用语言来界定。

source_text:
The reproductions of free studies may indicate that the possibilities
are endless. Since showing such samples may present a handicap, one
might stimulate a beginning with thematic suggestions.
translated_text: 自由习作的复制图版也许表明，可能性是无穷无尽的。由于展示这样的样本可能构成一种妨碍，人们或许可以用主题建议来激发开端。

source_text: Experience has taught that pairs of contrasts
translated_text: 经验表明，成对的对比

source_text: invoke a more distinct "meaning" and a more precise "reading."
translated_text: 会唤起更明确的“意义”和更精确的“解读”。

source_text:
First themes:
gay
sad
translated_text:
最初的主题：
快乐
悲伤

source_text:
young- old
major -
minor
translated_text:
年轻——年老
大调——
小调

source_text:
More daring:
bright -
dull
translated_text:
更大胆的：
明亮——
暗钝

source_text:
early -
late
active -
passive
translated_text:
早——
晚
主动——
被动

source_text: These themes easily evoke discussions without end, since verbal reactions
translated_text: 这些主题很容易引发无休止的讨论，因为言语反应

source_text: to the associations with color differ vastly from person to person.
translated_text: 与色彩相关的联想因人而异，差别极大。

source_text:
Another stimulation is the problem of free studies in colors of a limited range.
This means a restricted palette with, for instance, only contrasting
or only adjacent colors, with selections of preferred or of disliked colors.
translated_text:
另一种刺激是有限色域中的自由习作问题。
这意味着一种受限制的调色板，例如，只使用对比色
或只使用邻近色，并从偏爱的颜色或厌恶的颜色中进行选择。

source_text: Any of these cases may aim for concord or discord.
translated_text: 这些情况中的任何一种都可以旨在求得和谐或不和谐。

source_text:
Such and other restrictions usually result from a personal choice.
More revealing, though harder to do, is the submission to selections
by others. To work with the preference of others, to subordinate
to someone else's palette or instrumentation, should be not only permitted
but encouraged.
translated_text:
这类以及其他限制通常出自个人选择。
不过，更有启示性、也更难做到的，是服从他人的选择。
使用他人的偏好来工作，服从
别人的调色板或配器，不仅应当被允许，
而且应当受到鼓励。

source_text: All this is to promote competition. And with that comes evaluation
translated_text: 这一切都是为了促进竞争。随之而来的便是评价

source_text: through comparison, which in the end means judgment.
translated_text: 通过比较，而这最终意味着判断。

source_text:
A strong challenge to a class is to work with 3 or 4 given colors
selected by a teacher or student. This and a continued use of disliked colors
will teach that preferences and dislikes-as in life so with color
-usually result from prejudices, from lack of experience and insight.
translated_text:
对一个班级来说，一项强有力的挑战是使用教师或学生选定的3种或4种给定颜色
进行工作。这一点，以及持续使用不喜欢的颜色，
将会教人明白，偏爱与厌恶——在生活中如此，在色彩上亦如此——
通常源于偏见，源于缺乏经验和洞察。

source_text: Stripes-restricted juxtaposition
translated_text: 条带——受限制的并置

source_text:
The first attempts to produce "free studies" usually result in the dominance
of form or shape-and often very pronounced-over color.
translated_text:
最初尝试制作“自由习作”时，通常会导致形式或形状
凌驾于色彩之上——而且往往十分明显。

source_text:
This means, in most cases, that the outlines of the colors predominate.
And, as visually the loudest, they are noticed first. Thus color appears
of secondary interest, or only as accompaniment of shape.
translated_text:
这意味着，在多数情况下，色彩的轮廓占据主导。
而且，作为视觉上最响亮的部分，它们首先被注意到。因此，色彩显得
只是次要的兴趣所在，或仅仅作为形状的伴随物。

source_text: And this remains the normal result so long as the most decisive difference
translated_text: 只要人们还没有清楚认识到

source_text:
between color in paper and color in paint is not clearly recognized:
colors in paper always consist of outspoken flat areas
translated_text:
纸中色彩与颜料中色彩之间最决定性的差异，这就仍会是正常结果：
纸中的色彩总是由鲜明的平面区域构成，

source_text:
which present even colors reaching precisely from edge to edge.
And the edges, by their very nature as uninterrupted endless contours,
again advocate shape first.
translated_text:
呈现出从一边精确延伸到另一边的均匀色彩。
而边缘由于其作为不间断、无尽轮廓的本性，
又再次首先为形状发声。

source_text: For this reason, it is advisable to recommend torn papers for the beginning
translated_text: 因此，建议初学时使用撕开的纸张是适宜的，

source_text:
as they ordinarily offer looser and freer edges
than cut papers.
More experience will lead to other means of softening or hardening
color boundaries: smaller or greater contrasts of hue or of light;
elemental or complex shapes; curved, straight, broken, or dotted lines.
translated_text:
因为它们通常比裁切的纸张提供更松散、更自由的边缘。
更多经验将引向其他软化或强化
色彩边界的手段：色相或明度上较小或较大的对比；
基本形或复杂形；曲线、直线、断线或点线。

source_text:
By combining colors exclusively in stripes-that is,
in stretched, narrow rectangles, all of the same length, varying
only in width, and touching each other in full length-
translated_text:
通过只以条带来组合色彩——也就是说，
以拉长的狭窄矩形，长度全都相同，
只在宽度上变化，并且彼此全长相接——

source_text:
we are led to overlook their rather equal shapes and to consider them
almost shapeless.
translated_text:
我们便被引导去忽略它们颇为相同的形状，并将其视为
几乎没有形状。

source_text:
As to placement of the stripes in horizontal or vertical direction,
the latter appears more practicable. In a left-right and
therefore sideward contact, color interaction usually
translated_text:
至于条带采用水平还是垂直方向来放置，
后者看来更为可行。在左右、
因而是侧向的接触中，色彩的相互作用通常

source_text:
is more easily comprehensible than within an up-down connection.
And with this, our reading, connecting, grouping, and separating
of the color stripes is easier.
translated_text:
比在上下连接中更容易理解。
因此，我们对色彩条带的阅读、连接、分组和分离
也更为容易。

source_text:
The first task is to organize a large number of color stripes-
all narrow, of varying width but equal length, all vertical and touching
each other, presenting only 4 colors-and only later to choose more or fewer
colors.
translated_text:
第一项任务是组织大量色彩条带——
全都狭窄，宽度各异但长度相同，全都垂直并彼此相接，
只呈现4种颜色——只是后来才选择更多或更少的
颜色。

source_text:
The aim is to find an order in which, again relatively,
all 4 colors are equally important, or, respectively, equally unimportant.
In other words, none of the colors dominates.
We say "relatively" in consideration of our individual attitude toward color,
of our differing preferences for certain colors, and our dislikes of others.
translated_text:
目标是找到一种秩序，在这种秩序中，同样是相对而言，
所有4种颜色都同等重要，或者分别说，同等不重要。
换言之，没有一种颜色占据主导。
我们说“相对而言”，是考虑到我们个人对色彩的态度，
考虑到我们对某些颜色偏好的差异，以及对另一些颜色的厌恶。

source_text:
With a continuous alternation and recurrence of the 4 colors
innumerable combinations and arrangements are possible.
And the more they vary, the more they invite one to follow and to alter,
with a constant change in connecting and dividing, overlapping and intersecting
of seemingly many more than 4 colors.
translated_text:
通过4种颜色的连续交替与反复，
无数种组合和排列都是可能的。
而它们越是变化，就越会邀请人去追随并改变，
在连接与分割、重叠与交叉的不断变化中，
仿佛出现了远多于4种的颜色。

source_text:
We may consider such calculated juxtaposition as a symbol
of community spirit, of "live and let live," of "equal rights for all,"
of mutual respect.
translated_text:
我们可以把这种经过计算的并置视为一种象征，
象征共同体精神，象征“自己活，也让别人活”，象征“人人享有平等权利”，
象征相互尊重。

source_text:
We should also encourage working with very different colors,
so that light and color intensity may compete with
and balance each other.
translated_text:
我们还应鼓励使用差异很大的颜色，
使明度与色彩强度可以彼此竞争，
并相互平衡。

source_text:
Such studies in stripes will readily remind us of textiles,
and we may read and interpret them as fabrics of wool or cotton-
for various uses-of various color climates: from new to old, young to old,
modern to old-related to peoples, times, and periods.
translated_text:
这种条纹研究很容易使我们联想到纺织品，
我们可以把它们看作并解读为羊毛或棉布织物——
用于各种用途——具有各种色彩气候：从新到旧，从年轻到年老，
从现代到古老——与民族、时代和时期相关。

source_text:
The purpose is to stimulate again a reading of the meaning
of form, to invite verbal formulation of reaction to
our associations with climates in color.
translated_text:
其目的在于再次激发对形式意义的解读，
促使我们用语言表述对
色彩气候所引发联想的反应。

第二个关于色彩条纹的问题旨在获得不同的结果：
它暗示一种或多种颜色以及宽阔区域的主导地位；
并允许协调和/或从属关系。

source_text:
More freedom in the number and the choice of colors
and their extension and repetition is given.
But restrictions to equal height and vertical partitioning
remain, in order to avoid interference of form.
translated_text:
在颜色的数量与选择，
以及它们的延展和重复方面给予更多自由。
但等高和垂直分割的限制仍然保留，
以避免形式的干扰。

source_text:
Whereas the first task has reminded us of striped textiles,
here one may think of walls which are subdivided for
structural, illusional, decorative purposes.
translated_text:
如果说第一项任务使我们想起条纹纺织品，
那么在这里，人们可以想到为结构、幻觉、装饰目的
而被分割的墙面。

source_text:
Though the second type of color studies in stripes
leads usually to a more broad and bright palette-
in a positive reaction to the first, more restricted task-
it will again prove more profitable to aim
with fewer means toward more action.
translated_text:
虽然第二类条纹色彩研究
通常会导向一种更宽广、更明亮的调色板——
这是对第一项较受限制的任务的积极反应——
但事实将再次证明，以更少的手段
追求更多的作用会更有收获。

source_text: Fall leaf studies-an American discovery
translated_text: 秋叶研究——一项美国发现

source_text:
Nowhere in the world, it seems to us, is the autumn foliage as brilliant
in color as in the United States.
translated_text:
在我们看来，世界上似乎没有任何地方的秋季树叶
像美国那样色彩灿烂。

source_text:
When leaves are collected, pressed, and dried-eventually varnished,
even bleached, and sometimes also dyed or painted-they provide
a most welcome enrichment of any color paper collection.
translated_text:
当树叶被采集、压平并干燥——最后上清漆，
甚至漂白，有时还染色或上色——它们便为
任何彩纸收藏提供了极受欢迎的丰富补充。

source_text:
Collected in all varieties, in all possible shades of color
-in large numbers for an easy exchange between students-they are both
exciting to see and most stimulating to work with in free studies.
translated_text:
采集各种品类、各种可能色调的树叶——
数量充足，以便学生之间轻松交换——它们既
令人兴奋地可供观看，又极能激发自由研究中的操作。

source_text:
As studies show, these leaves work beautifully with color paper.
They add innumerable tints and shades, with modulations and shapes
translated_text:
正如研究所显示的，这些树叶与彩纸搭配效果极佳。
它们增添了无数的浅色与深色，带有调节变化和形状，

source_text:
that color papers do not have. They are used singly and in groups,
in parts and combined again, repeated and reversed. Always
translated_text:
这些是彩纸所不具备的。它们可以单独使用，也可成组使用，
可以局部使用再重新组合，可以重复，也可以反转。始终

source_text:
keep in mind the color before the shape. Colorful leaves suit all
ways of play and imagination for all kinds of order and placement.
Therefore, they remain a favorite means of study.
translated_text:
要把颜色置于形状之前来考虑。彩色树叶适合一切
游戏与想象方式，适合各种秩序和摆放。
因此，它们始终是一种备受喜爱的研究手段。

source_text:
Naturally, leaf studies are best done in their season, in autumn,
at other times with prepared, preserved leaves which, of course,
provide more subdued, less vivid colors.
translated_text:
自然，树叶研究最好在其时令进行，即在秋季；
其他时候则使用经过处理、保存的树叶，当然，
它们提供的是更柔和、不那么鲜明的颜色。

source_text: As leaf studies are free studies ( usually done as homework),
translated_text: 由于树叶研究属于自由研究（通常作为家庭作业完成），

source_text:
they are mentioned here under that title, as are studies in stripes.
(See plates xxv-2 and xxv-6.)
translated_text:
它们在这里与条纹研究一样，被列在这一标题之下。
（见图版 xxv-2 和 xxv-6。）

source_text:
The Masters-
color instrumentation
translated_text:
大师们——
色彩配器法

source_text: XIX
translated_text: XIX

source_text:
It should be clear by now that our way of studying color
does not start with the past-neither with works of the past
nor with its theories.
translated_text:
到现在应当已经清楚，我们研究色彩的方式
并不从过去开始——既不从过去的作品开始，
也不从过去的理论开始。

source_text:
As we begin principally with the material, color itself,
and its action and interaction as registered in our minds,
translated_text:
由于我们原则上从材料，即色彩本身，
以及它在我们心中被记录下来的作用与相互作用开始，

source_text: we practice first and mainly a study of ourselves.
translated_text: 我们首先并且主要是在实践一种对自身的研究。

source_text:
Thus, we replace looking backward by looking first at ourselves and
our surroundings, and replace retrospection with introspection.
translated_text: 因此，我们以首先审视自身及周围环境来取代回顾过去，以内省取代追溯。

source_text:
Though our own development and our own work are closest to us,
we see and appreciate encouragement from achievements of the past,
and gratefully pay practical respect to their originators
as often as the opportunity arises.
translated_text: 尽管我们自身的发展和我们自己的工作离我们最近，我们仍能从过去的成就中看到并领会鼓舞，并且每逢有机会，便怀着感激之情向其开创者致以切实的敬意。

source_text:
To honor the masters creatively is to compete with their attitude
rather than with their results, to follow an artistic understanding
of tradition-that is, to create, not to revive.
translated_text: 创造性地尊崇大师，就是与他们的态度竞争，而不是与他们的成果竞争；就是遵循一种对传统的艺术性理解——也就是说，去创造，而不是去复兴。

source_text:
Therefore, in our study of the masters-both past and present-
there is, beyond mere retrospection and above verbal analysis,
re-creating by re-performing
their selection and presentation of color,
their seeing and reading of color-
in other words, their giving a meaning to color.
translated_text:
因此，在我们研究大师——无论过去的还是当代的——时，除了单纯的回顾，超越文字分析之外，还有通过重新实践来重新创造：
他们对色彩的选择与呈现，
他们对色彩的观看与解读——
换言之，他们赋予色彩以意义。

source_text:
Singing a tune and playing it on instruments-
even more, conducting several instruments-
provides more contact, more insight than merely hearing the tune.
So cooking, normally and naturally, teaches more than reading recipes.
translated_text:
唱出一支曲调，并用乐器演奏它——
更进一步，指挥几件乐器演奏它——
比仅仅聆听这支曲调提供更多接触、更多洞见。
同样，烹饪通常且自然地比阅读食谱教给人更多。

source_text: As a conclusion, we transfer paintings by masters into color paper,
translated_text: 作为结论，我们把大师的绘画转化为彩色纸，

source_text: in order to identify their color instrumentation. (See plate x1x-1.)
translated_text: 以便识别其色彩配器。（见图版 x1x-1。）

source_text:
Our aim is not production of precise replicas
as copyists do in museums.
translated_text: 我们的目标并不是像博物馆里的临摹者那样制作精确的复制品。

source_text:
We try to give a general impression only as to climate, temperature,
aroma, or sound of their work-not minute details.
translated_text: 我们只试图给出关于其作品的气候、温度、气息或声音的总体印象——而不是细枝末节。
这种研究的目的既不是要弄清，例如，使用的是群青还是钴蓝，也不是要记录画家调色板的事实内容。

source_text: It is another means of learning to develop
translated_text: 这是学习培养

source_text: a sensitive and critical eye for color relatedness.
translated_text: 一种对色彩关系既敏感又具有批判性的眼光的另一种手段。

source_text:
The result of our transformation of paintings into color paper
depends on several limitations. Naturally, in making them,
we depend on reproductions.
translated_text: 我们把绘画转化为彩色纸，其结果取决于若干限制。自然，在制作这些转化作品时，我们依赖复制品。

source_text:
In 3- and 4-color halftones, all colors are represented as optical mixtures
of 3 or 4 standardized inks. These are mostly transparent,
mixing not only with each other
but also with the white paper underneath.
That is to say, such reproductions are physically already
of an absolutely different instrumentation.
translated_text:
在三色和四色网目版中，所有颜色都表现为三种或四种标准化油墨的光学混合。这些油墨大多是透明的，
不仅彼此混合，
也与其下方的白纸混合。
也就是说，这类复制品在物理上已经属于一种完全不同的配器。

source_text:
The resulting false and misleading smoothness, even slickness or sweetness,
and the dramatized brightness of so-called high-key color reproduction
are easily and pleasantly counteracted and corrected by paper colors.
This is the result of the opacity or visual weight of paper colors,
and their varying density and volume.
translated_text:
由此产生的虚假而误导的平滑感，甚至光滑感或甜腻感，
以及所谓高调色彩复制中被戏剧化的明亮度，
都很容易且令人愉快地由纸的颜色加以抵消和校正。
这是纸色的不透明性或视觉重量，
以及其不同密度和体量所造成的结果。

source_text: As a rule, paintings transferred to color paper look painted;
translated_text: 通常，转化为彩色纸的绘画看起来像是画出来的；

source_text:
they do not look printed.
In the case of a Van Gogh and a Soutine, we easily regain
the effect of dramatic execution.
And works of Matisse appear again as juxtaposition of flat color areas,
opaque as well as untextured.
translated_text:
它们看起来不像是印刷出来的。
在梵高和苏丁的作品中，我们很容易重新获得
充满戏剧性的执行效果。
而马蒂斯的作品则再次显现为平面色域的并置，
既不透明，也没有肌理。

source_text:
With such studies we submit to formulations of the past
in order to provoke further comparisons
of different attitudes, temperaments, mentalities, and personalities-
all for the sake of continued self-criticism and self-evaluation.
This proclaims creative action ahead of retrospective reaction.
translated_text:
通过这样的研究，我们服从于过去的表述，
以激发对不同态度、气质、心性和个性的进一步比较——
这一切都是为了持续的自我批判和自我评估。
这宣告的是创造性的行动先于回顾性的反应。

source_text: The Weber-Fechner Law-
translated_text: 韦伯—费希纳定律——

source_text: the measure in mixture
translated_text: 混合中的度量

source_text: xx
translated_text: xx

source_text:
In order to obtain a graduated scale of greys, M. E. Chevreul,
the author of the famous book "The Laws of Contrast of Colour,"
gave the following instructions (from the English translation of 1868,
page 5, paragraph u):
translated_text: 为了获得一个渐进的灰阶，《色彩对比定律》这部名著的作者 M. E. Chevreul 给出了如下说明（引自 1868 年英译本，第 5 页，第 u 段）：

source_text:
Upon a sheet of cardboard divided into ten stripes,
each about a quarter of an inch broad,
translated_text:
在一张分成十条带的硬纸板上，
每条约四分之一英寸宽，

source_text:
lay a uniform tint of India ink. As soon as it is dry,
lay a second tint on all the stripes except the first.
As soon as the second is dry, lay a third one
on all the stripes except the first and second,
and so on all the rest, so as to have
ten flat tints gradually increasing
in depth from the first to the last.
translated_text:
均匀地涂上一层印度墨色调。待其一干，
就在除第一条以外的所有条带上再涂第二层色调。
待第二层一干，就在除第一、第二条以外的所有条带上
再涂第三层，
其余依此类推，以便得到
十个平涂色调，从第一条到最后一条
深度逐渐增加。

source_text:
All this sounds quite convincing, so convincing that one wonders
whether anyone has ever doubted that the result would be as promised-
whether anyone has ever followed these instructions, including M. Chevreul
translated_text:
这一切听起来颇有说服力，甚至令人不禁怀疑，
是否曾有人质疑过结果会不会如所承诺的那样——
是否曾有人真正按照这些说明去做，包括谢弗勒尔先生

source_text: himself.
translated_text: 本人。

source_text: All this, of course, refers to volume color (see page 45) but,
translated_text: 当然，这一切指的是体积色（见第45页），但是，

source_text:
most important, it also leads to a new insight into color mixture-
after an unavoidable surprise is recognized.
translated_text:
更重要的是，它也会引向对色彩混合的一种新认识——
在一个不可避免的意外被认出之后。

source_text:
The surprise is that the gradual "increase in depth" promised above
does not appear-as most people will expect-in a succession of
equal steps. Nor, when mixing pigments, does an equal gradation appear
when an equal quantity of the same color is continually added.
translated_text:
这个意外是，上文所承诺的逐渐“增加深度”，
并不会像大多数人所预期的那样，以一连串
相等的步级显现出来。同样，在混合颜料时，
当不断加入等量的同一种颜色，也不会出现均等的渐变。

source_text:
In this case a continued application of such layers would
unavoidably lead to such a degree of decrease that the initial increase would
disappear in a final, unsurpassable, and unchanging saturation.
translated_text:
在这种情况下，持续施加这样的层次，
将不可避免地导致一种程度的递减，以至最初的增加
会消失于最终的、不可超越且不再变化的饱和之中。

source_text:
Analyzing Chevreul 's method of applying one layer on top of another,
one recognizes not only an additive mixture with regard to color, but
also a subtractive mixture with regard to light.
translated_text:
分析谢弗勒尔将一层叠加在另一层之上的方法，
人们不仅会认识到，就色彩而言存在一种加法混合，
而且，就光而言也存在一种减法混合。

source_text:
More precisely, this demonstrates an arithmetical progression
in both directions-and both are physical progressions only.
translated_text:
更确切地说，这表明在两个方向上都有一种算术级数——
而二者都只是物理级数。

source_text: In the diagrams on page 56, this physical fact is presented
translated_text: 在第56页的图示中，这一物理事实

source_text:
by a row of rising steps of equal height and width, the movement of which
follows a straight line.
translated_text:
由一排高度和宽度相等的上升阶梯呈现出来，其运动
遵循一条直线。

source_text:
As said before, and clearly shown in Klee's water colors, the rate of
increase gradually decreases. Therefore, the rise of the steps will be
less and less high. Consequently, the physically straight line of
direction becomes psychologically a curve, ending in a horizontal line
representing saturation, which ends both increase and decrease.
translated_text:
如前所述，并且正如克利的水彩画清楚显示的那样，
增加的速率会逐渐降低。因此，阶梯的升高会
越来越小。于是，物理上的直线方向
在心理上变成了一条曲线，终止于一条水平线，
这条水平线代表饱和，并终止了增加与减少。

source_text:
This leads to the question: what is necessary to produce a visually
even progression in mixture?
translated_text:
这就引出一个问题：要在混合中产生视觉上
均匀的级进，需要什么？

source_text: The answer was found by Weber (Wilhelm Eduard, 1804-91) and Fechner
translated_text: 答案由韦伯（威廉·爱德华，1804—91）和费希纳

source_text:
(Gustav Theodor, 1801-87). It is formulated in the so-called Weber-Fechner Law:
The visual perception of an arithmetical progression depends upon a physical
geometric progression.
translated_text:
（古斯塔夫·特奥多尔，1801—87）发现。它被表述在所谓的韦伯—费希纳定律中：
对算术级数的视觉感知，取决于物理上的
几何级数。

source_text:
Explained in diagrams shown on the next page, this means:
If the first 2 steps measure 1 and 2 units in rise, then
translated_text:
用下一页所示图解来说明，这意味着：
如果前2级的上升量分别为1和2个单位，那么

source_text:
step 3 is not only 1 unit more (that is, 3 in an arithmetical proportion),
but is twice as much (that is, 4 in a geometric
proportion). The successive steps then measure 8, 16, 32, 64 units.
Such increases describe an upward curve ending in a straight vertical line, meaning,
again, saturation.
translated_text:
第3级并不只是多1个单位（也就是说，在算术比例中为3），
而是为其两倍（也就是说，在几何
比例中为4）。随后的各级便量得8、16、32、64个单位。
这样的增加描绘出一条向上的曲线，终止于一条垂直直线，这再次意味着
饱和。

source_text:
However, the reading of such geometric increase will describe a straight line
in our mind. We think and "feel" that we read steps of equal height.
translated_text:
然而，对这种几何增加的读取，会在我们的心中描绘出一条直线。
我们认为并“感觉到”自己读到的是高度相等的阶梯。

source_text:
To demonstrate this surprising discrepancy between physical fact and psychic effect,
and, more important, to become convinced of it through one's own experience,
the following exercise is recommended:
translated_text:
为了展示这种物理事实与心理效果之间令人惊讶的差异，
并且，更重要的是，为了通过自己的经验确信这一点，
建议做如下练习：

source_text:
On a white paper, layers of very light transparent coats of a very thin color
are placed on top of each other; first, as M. Chevreul suggests,
in an arithmetical progression (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, etc. layers); then, in a
second row, in a geometric progression (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, etc. layers),
on the same paper. In both rows, contiguous steps of equal width are required.
translated_text:
在一张白纸上，将极薄颜色的极淡透明涂层
一层层叠加起来；首先，按照谢弗勒尔先生的建议，
以算术级数进行（1、2、3、4、5等层）；然后，在
第二排中，以几何级数进行（1、2、4、8、16等层），
涂在同一张纸上。两排中都要求有宽度相等的相邻阶梯。

source_text:
THIS PHYSICAL FACT
REDUCES TO
THIS PSYCHOLOGICAL EFFECT
translated_text:
这一物理事实
归约为
这一心理效果

source_text:
THIS PHYSICAL FACT
PRODUCES
THIS PSYCHOLOGICAL EFFECT
translated_text:
这一物理事实
产生
这一心理效应

source_text:
For accurate comparison of the 2 rows-of arithmetical and geometric increases-
precision is necessary. For this reason, water color should be avoided,
because it rarely provides even coats and always ends not only
in heavy but in unevenly heavy contours. Most advisable is the use of
film-like acetate sheets of the thinnest tints available, with adhesive backs
which provide the advantages of easy montage and invisible paste.
There are several makes, such as "Zip-a-tone," "Artype," and "Cello-tak."
translated_text: 为了准确比较这两排——算术递增与几何递增——精确性是必要的。因此，应避免使用水彩，因为它很少能形成均匀的涂层，而且最终总会产生不仅厚重、并且厚薄不均的轮廓。最可取的是使用最浅色调的薄膜状醋酸纤维片，且带有背胶；这种材料具有易于拼贴和黏贴痕迹不可见的优点。有若干品牌，例如“Zip-a-tone”“Artype”和“Cello-tak”。

source_text:
In case these are not available, very thin translucent paper (waxed sandwich paper)
might demonstrate-in transparence-the 2 different effects,
when observed against light.
translated_text: 如果这些材料无法取得，也可以用很薄的半透明纸（蜡质三明治包装纸），在透光观察时，以透明性展示这两种不同效果。

source_text:
For another demonstration in turbid means-in reflected light-
layers of thinnest whites on black paper will provide proof in an opposite direction-
the very different effects of arithmetical and geometric increase or decrease.
translated_text: 若要在混浊媒介中——以反射光——作另一种演示，在黑纸上叠加最薄的白色层，将从相反方向提供证明——即算术递增或递减与几何递增或递减所产生的极为不同的效果。

source_text:
These studies also teach that the "decreasing increase" can be seen in the boundaries
separating the steps: In an arithmetical order of contiguous mixtures,
the boundaries gradually become softer, whereas in a geometric order the boundaries
remain equally distinct.
translated_text: 这些研究还表明，“递减的递增”可以在分隔各阶的边界中看到：在相邻混合的算术秩序中，边界逐渐变得柔和；而在几何秩序中，边界则保持同样清晰。

source_text:
Such studies, of course, are only theoretically true. Because of slight material
imprecisions, the studies show occasional aberrations from the rule.
translated_text: 当然，这类研究只是在理论上成立。由于材料上存在轻微的不精确，这些研究会显示出偶尔偏离规则的异常。

source_text:
Though the Weber-Fechner Law enables "equal stepping up" (in light and in dark,
within specific hues), it is deflected by the relativity of color.
translated_text: 虽然韦伯—费希纳定律使“等量递增”（在特定色相内的明与暗中）成为可能，但它会受到色彩相对性的偏转。

source_text:
In steps which are not much wider than they are deep, these steps visually do not
remain horizontal or on an even level, as in the diagram on page 58, left.
translated_text: 在宽度并不比深度大很多的阶梯中，这些阶梯在视觉上并不保持水平或处于同一平面，如第58页左侧图示所示。

source_text:
In steps which are broader, a "fluting" effect occurs, reminiscent of the
channeling of Doric columns, as in the diagram on page 58, right.
translated_text: 在较宽的阶梯中，会出现一种“凹槽”效果，使人联想到多立克柱的沟槽，如第58页右侧图示所示。

source_text:
A convincing outdoor demonstration of the Weber-Fechner Law is presented
in swimming pools painted, for example, blue. Because of reflection, the
water appears thinly tinted blue. Visually following the steps downward,
one easily recognizes an increase of blueness. Since the steps are
equally deep, equal amounts of blueness are added. This
arithmetical physical proportion is again perceived in a decreasing geometric proportion.
translated_text: 韦伯—费希纳定律有一个令人信服的户外演示，可见于例如涂成蓝色的游泳池。由于反射，水显得带有淡淡的蓝色。沿着台阶向下看，人们很容易辨认出蓝色程度的增加。由于台阶深度相等，增加的蓝色量也相等。这种算术式的物理比例，又一次被感知为递减的几何比例。

source_text:
When the edges of the steps are compared in a downward direction they appear
gradually softer. There is a double reason for this effect: First, as the increase
of blueness simultaneously reduces light, the defining edges of the steps
appear less clear. Second, as the increase in blueness also decreases,
the contrast between neighboring blues is reduced.
translated_text: 当沿向下的方向比较台阶边缘时，它们显得逐渐柔和。这一效果有双重原因：第一，随着蓝色的增加同时降低了明度，台阶的界定边缘显得不那么清楚。第二，随着蓝色的增加也在减弱，相邻蓝色之间的对比也随之降低。

source_text: Consequently, the separation of the edges of the steps becomes
translated_text: 因此，台阶边缘之间的分隔变得

source_text:
less distinct. Both reasons follow the Weber-Fechner Law and are unrelated
to any law of light refraction. Although light refraction also causes
translated_text: 不那么清晰。这两个原因都遵循韦伯—费希纳定律，与任何光折射定律无关。虽然光折射也会造成

source_text:
illusion in visual perception, it presents an entirely different principle
because it is concerned with an optical effect. The Weber-Fechner Law
explains a perceptual phenomenon.
translated_text: 视觉知觉中的错觉，但它呈现的是一种完全不同的原则，因为它涉及的是一种光学效应。韦伯—费希纳定律解释的是一种知觉现象。

source_text:
It is surprising and unfortunate that the Weber-Fechner Law is almost
unknown among colorists. Its importance is more recognized in physics-in astronomy,
electricity, and acoustics. It also proves to be important in psychology-in the perception
of sound, weight, temperature-as well as in the perception of light and color.
(See plate xx-1.)
The presentation below of the important Weber-Fechner discovery was simplified visually
and verbally for an easier understanding, but it should be emphasized that all Weber-
Fechner calculations are done in logarithmic progressions which theoretically do not reach
saturation points.
translated_text:
令人惊讶且遗憾的是，韦伯—费希纳定律在色彩研究者中几乎无人知晓。它的重要性在物理学中得到更多承认——在天文学、电学和声学中都是如此。它在心理学中也证明十分重要——在对声音、重量、温度的知觉中，以及在对光和色彩的知觉中皆然。（见图版xx-1。）
下面对韦伯—费希纳这一重要发现的呈现，在视觉和文字上都作了简化，以便更易理解；但应强调的是，所有韦伯—费希纳计算都以对数级数进行，而这种级数在理论上并不会达到饱和点。

translated_text: 实际感知到的

to humidity in color
translated_text:

source_text: XXI
translated_text: XXI

source_text: Earlier, when explaining light intensity as lightness and color intensity
translated_text: 前文在把光的强度解释为明度、把色彩强度

source_text:
as brightness, we found that agreement is easier in the first case,
and difficult in the second.
translated_text: 解释为亮度时，我们发现，在前一种情况下较容易达成一致，而在后一种情况下则很困难。

source_text: This is because, in defining such qualities, we deal on the one side with
translated_text: 这是因为，在界定这类性质时，我们一方面处理的是

source_text:
physical facts and on the other with perceptual reactions
which permit either a factual measure or an interpretation of illusions.
As a result, there are in the latter case various views and opinions,
and different, if not contradictory, readings.
translated_text: 物理事实，另一方面处理的是知觉反应；后者既可能允许事实性的测量，也可能允许对错觉的解释。因此，在后一种情况下存在各种看法和意见，以及不同的、甚至相互矛盾的解读。

source_text:
Any measuring of light-dark qualities is not unrelated to a scaling
of light-heavy relationships. Light-dark and light-heavy lead easily
to soft-hard comparisons; or, quick-slow and early-late connect
translated_text: 对明暗性质的任何测量，都并非与轻重关系的标度无关。明暗与轻重很容易引向软硬比较；或者，快慢与早晚相联

source_text: with young-old, and with warm-cool, as well as with wet-dry.
translated_text: 与年轻—年老、暖—冷以及湿—干相联系。

source_text: Such and other chain connections have led even to such opposites
translated_text: 诸如此类的链式联系甚至导致了这样的对立，

source_text: as here and there, indicating spatial differentiation.
translated_text: 如这里与那里，表示空间上的区分。

source_text:
The 2 most comprehensive of the above polarities in color are first,
light-dark and light-heavy, and second, the temperature contrast
translated_text:
上述色彩极性中最为全面的两种，第一是
明—暗和轻—重，第二是温度对比

source_text: warm-cool.
translated_text: 暖—冷。

source_text: In defining the placement of such contrasts within color circles,
translated_text: 在界定这些对比在色相环中的位置时，

source_text:
we will see, besides their uneven distribution and their so-called
neutrals separating them, their slight overlappings of each other
when we compare one circle with the other. (See diagrams, next page.)
translated_text:
我们会看到，除了它们分布不均，以及将它们分隔开的所谓
中性之外，当我们把一个色相环同另一个相比较时，
它们彼此之间还有轻微的重叠。（见下一页图解。）

source_text:
As to warm and cool, it is accepted in Western tradition that normally
blue appears cool and that the adjacent group, yellow-orange-red, looks warm.
translated_text:
关于暖与冷，西方传统公认的是，通常
蓝色显得冷，而相邻的一组色彩，即黄—橙—红，看起来暖。

source_text: As any temperature can be read higher or lower in comparison with other
translated_text: 正如任何温度在与其他

source_text:
temperatures, these qualifications are only 1·elative. Therefore, there
are also warm blues and cool reds possible within their own hues.
translated_text:
温度比较时都可被解读为较高或较低一样，这些限定只是相对的。因此，
在各自的色相之内，也可能有暖的蓝和冷的红。

source_text:
But when these temperature indicators, red and blue, are combined
with color neutrals, as whites, blacks, and greys, and with their
translated_text:
但是，当这些温度指示色，即红与蓝，同色彩中性色，
如白、黑、灰，以及同它们的

source_text:
mixtures, particularly in mixtures with the temperature neutrals
green and violet, then personal interpretations of temperatures
translated_text:
混合色结合时，尤其是在同温度中性色
绿与紫的混合中，对温度的个人解释

source_text: may easily become disparate.
translated_text: 就很容易变得彼此悬殊。

source_text:
Therefore, it will be comprehensible that such theories of interpretation
may lead to and end in personal beliefs. So it is not surprising
that the warm-cool principle in color which successfully dominated
the Munich school of painting around the turn of the century resulted
finally in fruitless controversies.
translated_text:
因此，可以理解，这类解释理论可能导致并最终归结为个人信念。因此，
色彩中的暖—冷原则曾在世纪之交前后成功地主导
慕尼黑画派，最终却导致了
无结果的争论，这并不令人惊讶。

source_text:
It was successful in gaining followers by offering a theory for defining
spatial relationship of colors, through their higher and lower illusional
temperature. As this warm-cool relationship was closely connected
with the light-dark contrast, the hardest but apparently lasting
conversion then was that light was cold and shadows warm, at least
outdoors. It split up in factions of different beliefs about the function
of cool and warm with regard to spatial directions in painting, whether
the here contra there was decisive, or the above contra below, or
the in contra out. A clear example of these opposites is the contrast
between Boucher's receding deepening with vermilion red,
and Rubens' advancing heightening with white.
translated_text:
它之所以能够成功地赢得追随者，是因为它提供了一种理论，用以通过色彩较高或较低的幻觉
温度来界定色彩的空间关系。由于这种暖—冷关系同
明—暗对比密切相连，当时最艰难但显然持久的
转变便是认为光是冷的，而阴影是暖的，至少在户外如此。
它分裂成若干派别，各自对绘画中冷与暖相对于空间方向的功能抱有不同信念：
究竟是这里与那里的对立起决定作用，还是
上与下的对立，抑或是
内与外的对立。这些对立的一个清晰例子，是
布歇用朱红造成的后退式加深，
与鲁本斯用白色造成的前进式提亮之间的对比。

source_text:
All this may be a reason why the warm-cool contrast is not in fashion
today, although a new theory declares warm near and cool far, because
the former is of longer and the latter of shorter wave length, and
they are, therefore, optically registered in different ways.
But optical and perceptual registration are not necessarily
parallel. (See plate xxr-1.)
translated_text:
这一切或许可以解释，为什么暖—冷对比如今并不流行，
尽管有一种新理论宣称暖色近、冷色远，因为
前者波长较长，后者波长较短，
因此它们在光学上以不同方式被记录。
但是，光学记录与知觉记录并不必然
平行。（见图版 xxr-1。）
