source_text: XXII
translated_text: XXII

source_text:
As a deception, this effect is related to our earlier experience
in which 2 colors appeared as 3 or 4 colors.
translated_text: 作为一种欺骗，这一效果与我们早先的经验有关，在那次经验中，2种颜色看起来像是3种或4种颜色。

source_text:
However, the additional illusionary colors
often are hard to define as to their hue.
translated_text: 然而，额外出现的幻觉色彩，其色相往往难以界定。

source_text:
They often appear as shadow on one side of the boundary
and as light reflected on the other side.
translated_text: 它们常常在边界的一侧显现为阴影，而在另一侧显现为反射的光。

source_text:
Or sometimes this vibration presents just a duplication
or triplication of the boundary line.
translated_text: 有时，这种振动又仅仅呈现为边界线的重复或三重化。

source_text: The conditions for these varying effects occur between colors
translated_text: 这些不同效果的条件发生在一些颜色之间，

source_text:
which are contrasting in their hues but also close or similar
in light intensity.
translated_text: 它们的色相形成对比，但在光强度上又接近或相似。

source_text:
Though this effect refers to the after-image,
its physio-psychological function apparently
seems not to have been clarified.
translated_text: 尽管这一效果涉及后像，但其生理—心理功能显然似乎尚未得到澄清。

source_text:
Often, under the same conditions, it is perceived by some people
and not by others.
translated_text: 在相同条件下，常常有些人能感知到它，而另一些人不能。

source_text:
It is visible and not visible with or without glasses;
or, similarly, with interchanging of near and far focus.
translated_text: 无论戴不戴眼镜，它都可能可见或不可见；或者，同样地，在近焦与远焦相互转换时也是如此。

source_text:
This initially exciting effect also feels aggressive
and often even uncomfortable to our eyes.
One finds it rarely used except for a screaming effect
in advertising, and as a result it is unpleasant, disliked, and avoided.
translated_text: 这种最初令人兴奋的效果，也会让我们的眼睛感到具有侵袭性，并且常常甚至不舒服。人们很少见到它被使用，除非是在广告中制造一种刺耳的效果；因此，它令人不悦、不受喜欢，并被避免使用。

source_text: (See plates xx11-1 and xx11-2.)
translated_text: （见图版xx11-1和xx11-2。）

source_text: 6i
translated_text: 6i

source_text:
Equal light intensity-
vanishing boundaries
translated_text:
相等的光强度——
消失的边界

source_text: XXIII
translated_text: XXIII

source_text:
Though rarely perceived, it is a fact that articulate boundaries
between colors can be made nearly unrecognizable, or made practically
invisible-through the choice of color alone.
translated_text: 尽管很少被感知到，但事实是，仅仅通过颜色的选择，就可以使颜色之间清晰分明的边界变得几乎无法辨认，或实际上不可见。

source_text:
This very surprising and most exciting of all color phenomena depends,
like all other effects, on specific conditions.
translated_text: 这一在所有色彩现象中最令人惊讶、也最令人兴奋的现象，和所有其他效果一样，取决于特定条件。

source_text:
The effect is the opposite of the aforementioned vibrating boundaries,
and it is not possible between very contrasting hues.
It is confined to adjacent, neighboring colors and depends most decisively
on equal "light intensity." Only real equality in lightness
or an equivalent real equality in darkness produces the effect here aimed at
and searched for.
translated_text: 这一效果与前述振动的边界相反，而且不可能出现在色相对比非常强烈的颜色之间。它仅限于相邻、毗连的颜色，并且最决定性地取决于相等的“光强度”。只有亮度上真正相等，或暗度上相应的真正相等，才会产生这里所指向并寻求的效果。

source_text: Now, since the term "equal value" has unfortunately been misused too often
translated_text: 现在，由于“相等明度”这一术语不幸地常常被误用于

source_text:
for colors lackingjust this quality, incompetent judgment has distorted
this term to a falsified measure. In this way, "equal values"
are more spoken about than realized-than actually seen.
translated_text: 恰恰缺乏这种性质的颜色，无能的判断已将这一术语歪曲成一种被篡改的衡量标准。这样一来，“相等明度”被谈论得多于被实现——多于被实际看见。

source_text:
Thus, we can safely state that very few people-including many colorists
and painters-have ever seen 2 adjacent colors
of true equal light value-that is, of exact equality in light,
of the same level of light, or, in a sense, the same altitude of light.
translated_text: 因此，我们可以有把握地说，极少有人——包括许多色彩学家和画家——曾经见过2种相邻颜色具有真正相等的光明度——也就是说，光上精确相等，处于同一光的层级，或者在某种意义上，处于同一光的高度。

source_text:
This will indicate that equal light intensity presents,
besides a most challenging exercise, a most difficult task
demanding most of all-patience.
translated_text: 这将表明，相等的光强度不仅是一项最具挑战性的练习，也是一项极其困难的任务，最重要的是要求——耐心。

source_text:
Because several of our color classes were not able to present
even 1 convincing color couple of equal light intensity,
this makes it an exercise for teachers willing to demonstrate
that in all teaching the personal example is the strongest incentive.
translated_text: 由于我们的几个色彩班甚至未能呈现出1组令人信服的、光强度相等的颜色配对，这便使它成为一项供教师使用的练习，用以证明在所有教学中，个人示范是最强的激励。

source_text: Earlier, right after the test "Which is the lighter and/ or darker?"
translated_text: 早先，在“哪一个更亮和/或更暗？”这一测试之后不久

source_text:
we had the opportunity to prepare for this difficult exercise,
which usually is the last exercise of our course.
translated_text:
我们有机会为这项艰难的练习做准备，
这通常是我们课程的最后一项练习。

source_text:
When we were collecting pairs of colors hard to distinguish as lighter or darker
we were often tempted to
consider some of them to be of "equal value."
translated_text:
当我们收集那些难以分辨何者较亮或较暗的成对颜色时，
我们常常会禁不住
把其中一些视为“等值”。

source_text:
At that time we learned that in cases difficult to decide upon,
which we named "near-equal light intensities," or "almost-equals,"
the after-image test can be a helpful measure. (See diagram, page 13.)
translated_text:
那时我们了解到，在难以判定的情形中，
我们称之为“近似相等的光强度”或“几乎相等”，
残像测试可以作为一种有帮助的衡量方法。（见第13页图示。）

source_text:
Though sometimes it may appear hopeless to find equal light intensities in paint
and painting, in color papers, or in our surroundings, we have found that
nature occasionally provides an opportunity to see them on cumulus clouds
against blue sky.
translated_text:
尽管有时在颜料
和绘画中、在彩纸中，或在我们的周围环境中找到相等的光强度似乎毫无希望，但我们发现，
自然偶尔会提供一个机会，让我们在蓝天映衬下的积云上看到它们。

source_text:
When these clouds, often lined up in horizontal groups,
appear gleaming white in their upper part in full sunlight,
separated from and rising against a distant deep blue,
translated_text:
当这些云朵，常常排列成水平的群组，
在充足阳光下，其上部呈现闪耀的白色，
与远处深蓝色的天空分离，并在其映衬下升起时，

source_text:
then underneath they show grey tones as shaded white.
These shades merge, or even hinge, with the same
but here very close blue. Why very close? This grey is
of the same light intensity as the neighboring blue below.
Thus, the boundaries between grey and blue vanish,
and we do not see where clouds end and where sky begins.
With such clouds, this is best observed with the sun at our backs.
translated_text:
那么在下方，它们便呈现出作为受阴影影响的白色的灰色调。
这些阴影与同样的、但在这里距离很近的蓝色相融合，甚至相互衔接。为什么说距离很近？这种灰色
与下方相邻的蓝色具有相同的光强度。
因此，灰色与蓝色之间的边界消失，
我们看不出云朵在哪里结束、天空从哪里开始。
对于这样的云，最好在太阳位于我们背后时观察。

source_text:
In order to produce this provocative color effect-but also the most
delicate one-all disturbing effects of paper (such as different surfaces)
and of montage (visible edges or paste marks) must be carefully avoided.
translated_text:
为了产生这种富有挑衅性的色彩效果——但也是最
精微的一种——必须小心避免纸张的一切干扰性影响（如不同的表面）
以及装裱的干扰性影响（可见的边缘或粘贴痕迹）。

source_text: (See plate xxm-2.)
translated_text: （见图版xxm-2。）

source_text:
Therefore, the 2 papers of equal light intensity must be mounted as
inlay (known as "intarsia").
translated_text:
因此，这2张具有相等光强度的纸必须以
镶嵌的方式安装（称为“intarsia”）。

source_text:
In this process the papers are placed within each other, instead of on top of
each other. Thus the thickness of the paper does not show, and, more important,
translated_text:
在这一过程中，纸张彼此嵌入，而不是彼此叠放。
这样纸张的厚度就不会显现，而且更重要的是，

source_text:
its very disturbing shadows are eliminated-provided the papers are of
equal thickness.
translated_text:
其极具干扰性的阴影也被消除——前提是这些纸张
厚度相同。

source_text:
For precision fitting, so that the joints will not show, the papers to be
inlaid are formed simultaneously in a single cutting.
translated_text:
为使接合精确、接缝不显露，待
镶嵌的纸张要在一次切割中同时成形。

source_text:
The finer the knife (best, the thinnest razor blade), the thinner the paper,
and the harder the ground to cut on (preferably glass), the better the
fitting will be and the less the joints will show. It is also essential that no glue
seep in to mark the joints.
translated_text:
刀越精细（最好是最薄的剃刀片），纸越薄，
切割所用的底面越坚硬（最好是玻璃），
嵌合就会越好，接缝也越不显眼。同样重要的是，胶水
不得渗入而使接缝留下痕迹。

source_text:
As the selection of the papers here demands patience, so their presentation
demands skill and cleanliness.
translated_text:
正如这里对纸张的选择需要耐心一样，它们的呈现
也需要技巧和洁净。

source_text: XXIV Color theories-color systems
translated_text: XXIV 色彩理论——色彩体系

source_text:
Originally, we began our color course with a presentation
of various color systems, of color theories.
translated_text:
最初，我们以介绍
各种色彩体系、色彩理论来开始我们的色彩课程。

source_text: With the discovery that color is the most relative medium in art, and that
translated_text: 随着我们发现色彩是艺术中最具相对性的媒介，并且

source_text: its greatest excitement lies beyond rules and canons,
translated_text: 其最大的激动人心之处存在于规则与准则之外，

source_text: a more sensitive discrimination was needed.
translated_text: 一种更为敏感的辨别力便成为必要。

source_text: The more a creative use of color developed, the less desirable became
translated_text: 色彩的创造性运用发展得越多，

source_text: a merely trustful and obedient application.
translated_text: 仅仅信任而顺从地加以应用就越不合需要。

source_text: A sensitive eye for color became our first concern.
translated_text: 对色彩敏感的眼睛成为我们首要关注的事。

source_text:
As a result, we came to present color systems not at the beginning
but at the end of our course.
translated_text:
因此，我们开始不在课程的开端，
而是在课程的末尾介绍色彩体系。

source_text:
We learned that their often beautiful order is more recognized and
appreciated when eyes and minds are-after productive exercises-
better prepared and more receptive.
In a laboratory course as described, it is not the ambition
translated_text:
我们了解到，当眼睛和心智在富有成效的练习之后
准备得更充分、也更具接受性时，这些体系往往美丽的秩序
会更容易被认识和欣赏。
在如上所述的实验室课程中，其志向并不是

source_text: to provide a comprehensive knowledge of many theories.
translated_text: 以便全面了解诸多理论。

source_text:
We can introduce only briefly the most important systems, which are
systematic groupings of the colors of the visible sun spectrum,
presented in 2-dimensional or 3-dimensional order.
However, we encourage extended interest in private study of theories.
translated_text:
我们只能简略介绍最重要的体系，即以二维或三维秩序呈现的、对可见太阳光谱诸色进行系统分组的体系。
不过，我们鼓励通过个人研习对这些理论作进一步探究。

source_text:
In presenting systems showing organized color relationship,
we usually start with the rarely published equilateral triangle
subdivided into 9 equilateral triangles, shown on page 66.
(See also plate xx1v-1.)
translated_text:
在介绍显示有组织的色彩关系的体系时，我们通常从很少发表的等边三角形开始，该三角形被细分为9个等边三角形，见第66页。
（另见图版xx1v-1。）

source_text:
We then refer to Schopenhauer's experiment on the relation and balance
of light with quantity within the color wheel, as explained on page 43.
translated_text: 随后，我们参照叔本华关于色轮内光与数量之间关系及平衡的实验，如第43页所解释。

source_text:
Of the contemporary systems, we present and analyze briefly the order
of the Munsell Color Tree, as well as the Ostwald Color System,
and show an offspring of the latter, the Faber Birren Color System.
translated_text: 在当代体系中，我们简要介绍并分析孟塞尔色彩树的秩序，以及奥斯特瓦尔德色彩体系，并展示后者的一个衍生体系，即费伯·比伦色彩体系。

source_text:
LUCID
SERIOUS
translated_text:
清晰
严肃

source_text: MIGHTY
translated_text: 强劲

source_text:
SERENE
MELANCHOLIC
translated_text:
宁静
忧郁

source_text:
PRIMARIES
SECONDARIES
TERTIARIES
translated_text:
原色
间色
复色

source_text: COMPLEMENTARIES WITH THEIR MIXTURES WHICH ARE DOMINATED BY THEIR PRIMARIES
translated_text: 互补色及其由各自原色支配的混合色

source_text:
Besides the difference in measurements within these systems,
we point out their practical value for industrial uses.
translated_text: 除了这些体系内部测量方式的差异之外，我们还指出它们在工业用途中的实用价值。

source_text:
We also show the limitations of the systems,
particularly in connection with painting.
Only the Munsell System presents a calculation of color quantity
with regard to area extension, without counting an additional
effect through recurrence.
translated_text:
我们还说明这些体系的局限，尤其是与绘画相关的局限。
只有孟塞尔体系提出了关于面积扩展的色彩数量计算，而不计入通过重复出现所产生的附加效果。

source_text:
We emphasize that color harmonies, usually the special interest
or aim of color systems, are not the only desirable relationship.
translated_text: 我们强调，色彩和谐通常是色彩体系的特殊关注点或目标，但它并非唯一可取的关系。

source_text:
As with tones in music, so with color-dissonance is as desirable
as its opposite, consonance.
After such brief introduction to established color systems
we introduce a more recent, most important development,
the spectrophotometer, for automatic color analysis.
translated_text:
如同音乐中的音一样，色彩中的不协和与其对立面协和同样可取。
在这样简要介绍既定色彩体系之后，我们介绍一种较新的、极其重要的发展：用于自动色彩分析的分光光度计。

source_text:
Since no purpose is served by going into further details of color systems,
it seems worth while to distinguish 3 basically different approaches
to color based upon the different interests of
the physicist, the psychologist, and the colorist.
To indicate only a single difference: whereas the primary colors
for the colorist (painters, designers) are, as we know, yellow-red-blue,
translated_text:
既然进一步详述色彩体系并无裨益，那么，根据物理学家、心理学家和色彩工作者的不同关注点，区分三种基本不同的色彩研究取向，似乎是值得的。
仅举一个差异来说明：如我们所知，对于色彩工作者（画家、设计师）来说，原色是黄、红、蓝，

source_text:
the physicist has 3 other primaries (not including yellow),
and the psychologist counts 4 primaries (the fourth being green),
plus 2 neutrals, white and black.
translated_text: 而物理学家有另外三种原色（不包括黄色），心理学家则计算四种原色（第四种为绿色），再加上两种中性色，白与黑。

source_text:
On teaching color-
some color terms
translated_text:
论色彩教学——
若干色彩术语

source_text: XXV
translated_text: XXV

source_text:
In the previous chapters we have presented a studio course,
or, if you prefer, a laboratory or workshop course
which opposes an administrative attitude of "theory and practice."
Naturally, practice is not preceded but followed by theory.
Such study promotes a more lasting teaching and learning
through experience. Its aim is development of creativeness
realized in discovery and invention-the criteria of creativity,
or flexibility, being imagination and fantasy. Altogether
it promotes "thinking in situations," a new educational concept
unfortunately little known and less cultivated, so far.
translated_text:
在前几章中，我们呈现了一门工作室课程，或者，如果你愿意，也可以说是一门实验室或工坊课程；它反对那种“理论与实践”的行政式态度。
自然，理论并不先于实践，而是随实践之后而来。
这种学习通过经验促进更持久的教与学。其目标是发展创造性，而创造性体现在发现与发明之中；创造性，或灵活性的标准，是想象力与幻想。总体而言，它促进“情境中的思考”这一新的教育观念；遗憾的是，迄今为止，这一观念鲜为人知，更少得到培养。

source_text:
We have described, up to now, the basic color problems to be solved,
and have presented them in a logical sequence in which each problem
prepares for following ones.
translated_text: 到目前为止，我们已经描述了有待解决的基本色彩问题，并按逻辑顺序呈现它们，在这一顺序中，每一个问题都为后续问题作准备。

source_text: The color plates selected for reproduction in this edition are strictly studies,
translated_text: 本版选作复制的彩色图版严格说来都是习作，

source_text:
that is, experimental tryouts. They aim at 1 distinct effect only, which,
at the time, was given as an exercise, obligatory for all members of the class.
These exercises are not meant to illustrate, or to decorate or beautify
something, but aim at the development of the ability to produce the
desired color effects. This reiterates our disbelief in self-expression, either
as a way of study or as its aim, in schools.
translated_text:
也就是说，是实验性的试作。它们只旨在达到一种明确的效果，而这种效果在当时是作为练习布置的，班上所有成员都必须完成。
这些练习并非意在说明、装饰或美化某物，而是旨在培养产生所需色彩效果的能力。这再次表明，我们不相信把自我表现作为学校学习的方式或目标。

source_text:
After too much non-teaching, non-learning, and a consequent non-seeing,
-in too many art "activities" -it is time to advocate again a basic
step-by-step learning which promotes recognition of insight coming
from experience, and evaluation resulting from comparison.
This, in sum, means recognition of development and improvement,
translated_text:
在太多艺术“活动”中，经过太多非教学、非学习以及随之而来的非观看之后，现在是时候重新倡导一种循序渐进的基础学习了；这种学习促使人们认识到来自经验的洞见，并认识到由比较产生的评价。
总而言之，这意味着承认发展与改进，

source_text:
that is, of growth, growth of ability. This growth is not only
a most exciting experience; it is inspiring and thus
the strongest incentive for intensified action, for continued investigation
translated_text: 也就是说，成长，能力的成长。这种成长不仅是一种极为令人振奋的体验；它还具有激励作用，因而是促使行动加强、研究持续进行的最强动力。

source_text: (search instead of re-search), for learning through conscious practice.
translated_text: （是探寻而非再探寻），也是通过有意识的实践来学习的最强动力。

source_text:
Gestalt psychology has proved that 3-dimensionality is perceived earlier
and more easily than 2-dimensionality. This explains why
children do not begin-as most art teachers still wish-with
painting and drawing, which are lateral abstractions on a
2-dimensional plane, but begin all by themselves with building,
constructing in space, on a ground and upward, in 3 dimensions.
translated_text: 格式塔心理学已经证明，三维性比二维性更早也更容易被感知到。这解释了为什么儿童并不是像大多数美术教师至今仍然希望的那样，从绘画和素描开始——它们是在二维平面上的横向抽象——而是自发地从搭建开始，在空间中建构，在地面上并向上建构，以三维方式进行。

source_text:
We believe that art education is an essential part of
general education, including so-called higher learning.
We promote, therefore, after a natural and easy laissez-faire
as an initial challenge, an early shift from aimless play to
directed study and work, which offers, with a basic training,
a continuous excitement of growth.
translated_text: 我们相信，艺术教育是普通教育的一个基本组成部分，也包括所谓的高等教育。因此，在最初以一种自然而轻松的放任作为挑战之后，我们提倡及早从漫无目的的游戏转向有方向的学习和工作；后者通过基础训练，提供一种持续的成长兴奋。

source_text:
To say this in psychological-educational terms, it means
a shift from a recognition of the first but primitive drive
for being occupied, entertained-Beschiiftigungstrieb-
to a more advanced drive, or better, need, for being
productive, creative-Gestaltungstrieb.
translated_text: 用心理学—教育学的术语来说，这意味着从承认最初但原始的驱力，即想要有所占据、获得娱乐的驱力——Beschäftigungstrieb——转向一种更高级的驱力，或者更确切地说，转向一种想要有生产性、有创造性的需要——Gestaltungstrieb。

source_text: The results of our trial-and-error experimentation, mostly done after
translated_text: 我们试错实验的结果，大多是在

source_text:
class, are exhibited at the beginning of the next class. (These studies
we call the "admission tickets" to the class.)
translated_text: 课后完成的，会在下一堂课开始时展出。（我们把这些习作称为进入课堂的“入场券”。）

source_text: They are then compared and evaluated by the entire class, students and
translated_text: 随后，全班学生和

source_text:
teacher. First, every class member makes his selection and
compares his preferences with his own contributions. Then, we
-that is, the teacher or a student or students-select the best examples
translated_text: 教师共同对它们进行比较和评价。首先，班上的每个成员都作出自己的选择，并把自己的偏好与自己的作品加以比较。然后，由我们——也就是教师，或某个学生，或若干学生——选出“心理工程”的最佳范例。

source_text:
of "psychological engineering." This qualification we confer on a
convincing presentation because it eliminates misleading reading of the
study's purpose and its desired effect.
translated_text: 我们把这一资格授予一种有说服力的呈现，因为它排除了对习作目的及其预期效果的误读。

source_text:
The normal procedure in presenting a new problem often is to show a sample
exercise and to point to its specific effect. The class is then asked to
produce equal effects with similar and other colors-without first being
told how to do it.
translated_text: 提出一个新问题时，通常的程序往往是展示一个练习样例，并指出它的特定效果。然后要求全班用相似的颜色以及其他颜色产生同等效果——但事先并不告诉他们该如何去做。

source_text:
After a while, a collection of the first trials-wrong as well as
"on the way" or right-will give an opportunity to lead, to direct,
translated_text: 过一段时间后，第一批尝试的汇集——无论是错误的，还是“在路上”的，或是正确的——将提供一个机会去引导、指导，

source_text:
to point at (or to indicate only by comparison forth and back) new
ways of promising investigation.
translated_text: 去指出（或仅通过前后比较来提示）新的、有前景的探究途径。

source_text:
It comes as a pleasant surprise in a step-by-step learning that the further
the course proceeds, the more each succeeding problem is accidentally
if not actually presented among the studies shown at the beginning of a
translated_text: 在循序渐进的学习中，一个令人愉快的惊喜是：课程越往前推进，后续每一个问题就越多地偶然地、即使不是实际上地，已经出现在一堂课开始时展示的习作之中。

source_text:
class. The teacher may prefer to present the new problem with this
"step ahead" (thus evading his own prepared presentation), as a new
direction emanating from the class. This "step ahead" will prove a most
contagious stimulus to the class.
translated_text: 教师也许会愿意借这个“领先一步”来提出新问题（从而避开自己预先准备好的呈现），把它作为一种由课堂中产生的新方向。这个“领先一步”将证明是对全班极具感染力的刺激。

source_text:
As basic rules of any language must be practiced continuously, and
therefore are never fixed, so exercises toward distinct color effects
never are done or over. New and different cases will be discovered
time and again, and should be presented to the class again and again. In
translated_text: 正如任何语言的基本规则都必须不断练习，因而从来不是固定不变的，针对明确色彩效果的练习也从来不会完成或结束。新的、不同的案例会一次又一次地被发现，也应一次又一次地呈现给全班。

source_text:
this way the study will be a mutual give and take. It will also show that
all thorough study is basic, and that all education is self-education.
This indicates that we expect from every student several solutions
to each problem.
translated_text: 通过这种方式，学习将成为一种相互的给予和接受。它还将表明，所有深入的学习都是基础性的，所有教育都是自我教育。这意味着我们期待每个学生针对每一个问题提出若干种解决方案。

source_text:
In the end, teaching is a matter not of method but of heart. Therefore,
the most decisive factor is the teacher's personality. His enthusiastic
concern with the student's growth counts more than how much he knows. It
is well known that "the teacher is always right," but rarely does this fact
elicit respect or sympathy; even less often does it prove competence
and authority.
translated_text: 归根结底，教学不是方法的问题，而是心的问题。因此，最具决定性的因素是教师的人格。他对学生成长的热切关注，比他知道多少更为重要。众所周知，“教师永远是对的”，但这一事实很少能引发尊敬或好感；它更少能够证明能力和权威。

source_text:
But the teacher actually is right and always will gain confidence
when he admits that he does not know, that he cannot decide, and,
as it often is with color, that he is unable to make a choice
or to give advice.
translated_text: 但是，当教师承认自己不知道，承认自己无法判断，并且像在色彩问题上常常发生的那样，承认自己不能作出选择或给出建议时，他实际上就是正确的，并且总会赢得信任。

source_text:
Besides, good teaching is more a giving of right questions
than a giving of right answers.
translated_text: 此外，好的教学更多在于提出正确的问题，而不是给出正确的答案。

source_text: A few color terms which need additional explanation
translated_text: 几个需要补充说明的色彩术语

source_text:
Relativity:
The length of any object is relative to the length
of longer or shorter objects. Thus, any in-between length, seen in 2 different
relationships, presents 2 different values. Therefore, changing measure
results in changing evaluations.
translated_text:
相对性：
任何物体的长度都相对于更长或更短物体的长度。因此，任何处于中间的长度，在两种不同关系中被观看时，都会呈现出两种不同的值。因此，度量的改变会导致评价的改变。

source_text:
In a similar way, as we learned before, 1 temperature can feel as 2.
Also, weight may be registered in different ways. If, of 3 hands,
the first holds only a small sheet of paper, the second a pile of
sheets or a book, and the third a pile of books, then physically
each of the 3 hands is exposed to weight. The first will feel nothing
or only a soft touch, the second clearly some pressure downward, and
the third may even feel pain.
translated_text:
以类似的方式，正如我们此前所了解到的，1种温度可以感觉成2种。
此外，重量也可能以不同的方式被感知。假如有3只手，
第一只手只拿着一小张纸，第二只手拿着一叠
纸或一本书，第三只手拿着一摞书，那么从物理上说，
这3只手中的每一只都承受着重量。第一只手会感觉不到什么，
或只感觉到轻柔的触碰；第二只手会清楚地感觉到某种向下的压力；
第三只手甚至可能感到疼痛。

source_text:
Relativity is caused by a variance of measure, by lack or avoidance of
standard rules, or by changing viewpoints. As a result, 1 phenomenon
has varying views, readings, and different meanings.
translated_text:
相对性是由衡量尺度的差异、标准规则的缺乏或回避，
或视角的改变所造成的。因此，1种现象会有不同的看法、
解读和不同的意义。

source_text:
This instability of value is extremely characteristic of color. Resulting
from the after-image, a light grey, for instance, may look dark at one
time and almost white at another, and at various times like a shade or a tint
of any color, as green may look reddish.
translated_text:
这种价值的不稳定性极其典型地体现在色彩上。例如，
由于后像的作用，浅灰色有时可能看起来很暗，
有时又几乎像白色，并且在不同的时候像任何颜色的阴影或淡色，
正如绿色可能看起来带红。

source_text:
The purpose of most of our color studies is to prove that color is
the most relative medium in art, that we almost never perceive
what color is physically.
translated_text:
我们大多数色彩研究的目的，是证明色彩是艺术中
最具相对性的媒介，证明我们几乎从不感知
色彩在物理上实际是什么。

source_text:
The mutual influencing of colors we call-interaction.
Seen from the opposite viewpoint, it is-interdependence.
translated_text:
色彩之间的相互影响，我们称之为——相互作用。
从相反的角度来看，它就是——相互依存。

source_text:
Though we were taught, only a few years ago, that there is no connection
whatever between visual and auditory perception, we know now that a color
changes visually when a changing tone is heard simultaneously. This,
of course, makes the relativity of color still more obvious,just as
tongue and eye perceptions interdepend when colors of food and of its
containers increase or diminish our appetite.
translated_text:
虽然仅仅几年前，我们还被教导说，视觉知觉与听觉知觉之间
完全没有任何联系，但我们现在知道，当一种变化的音调同时被听到时，
一种色彩在视觉上会发生变化。当然，这使色彩的相对性
更加显而易见，正如当食物及其容器的颜色增强或减弱我们的食欲时，
舌头与眼睛的知觉会相互依存。

source_text:
Factual-Actual:
In dealing with color relativity or color illusion, it is practical
to distinguish factual facts from actual facts.
translated_text:
事实的——实际的：
在处理色彩相对性或色彩错觉时，将事实性事实与实际性事实
区分开来是切实有用的。

source_text:
The data on wave length-the result of optical analysis of light spectra-
we acknowledge as fact.
translated_text:
关于波长的数据——对光谱进行光学分析所得的结果——
我们承认为事实。

source_text: This is a factual fact.
translated_text: 这是一个事实性事实。

source_text: It means something remaining what it is, something probably not undergoing changes.
translated_text: 它意味着某物保持其本来状态，意味着某物大概不会发生变化。

source_text:
But when we see opaque color as transparent or perceive opacity as translucence,
then the optical reception in our eye has changed in our mind to something
different. The same is true when we see 3 colors as 4 or as 2, or
4 colors as 3, when we see flat, even colors as intersecting colors and
their fluting effect, or when we see distinct 1-contour boundaries
doubled or vibrating or just vanishing.
translated_text:
但是，当我们把不透明的色彩看成透明的，或把不透明性感知为半透明时，
那么我们眼中的光学接收就已在我们的心智中变成了某种
不同的东西。当我们把3种颜色看成4种或2种，
或把4种颜色看成3种；当我们把平坦、均匀的颜色看成交叉的颜色及其
凹槽效果；或当我们看到清晰的1条轮廓边界
变成双重、颤动，或干脆消失时，情况也是如此。

source_text: These effects we call actual facts.
translated_text: 这些效果我们称为实际性事实。

source_text:
This kind of fact seems parallel to the common saying, "what actually
happened," that is, what happened in time, what went on, what moved,
what developed.
translated_text:
这类事实似乎与通常所说的“实际发生了什么”相平行，
也就是说，在时间中发生了什么，进行着什么，移动了什么，
发展了什么。

source_text:
But "actual size" usually means something fixed, something remaining
permanent, standing still. Therefore, "factual size" would be more
truthful because "actual" is related to "action." It is something not
fixed, but changing with time.
translated_text:
但是，“实际大小”通常意味着某种固定的东西，某种保持
永久、静止不动的东西。因此，“事实大小”会更
真实，因为“实际”与“行动”相关。它不是某种
固定的东西，而是随时间变化的东西。

source_text:
"Action" is the noun for the verb "to act." Acting in visual presentation is
to change by giving up, by losing identity. When we act, we change appearance
and behavior, we act as someone else.
translated_text:
“行动”是动词“行动”的名词形式。在视觉呈现中，行动就是
通过放弃、通过丧失身份而发生改变。当我们表演时，我们改变外貌
和行为，我们扮演成另一个人。

source_text:
For further clarification, therefore, actors who present only themselves
remain always the same. They may appear interesting, but they do not act.
In our terms they remain factual. However, when an actor is able to appear
as Henry VIII, so that we overlook or forget who he factually is, and
when he also can be expected to play Henry IX or Henry x, then he is a
real actor, able to give up his own identity and present someone else's
appearance and personality.
translated_text:
因此，为了进一步说明，那些只呈现自身的演员
始终保持不变。他们或许显得有趣，但他们并没有表演。
用我们的术语来说，他们仍然是事实性的。然而，当一名演员能够显现为
亨利八世，以至于我们忽略或忘记他事实上是谁，
并且当他也可以被期待去扮演亨利九世或亨利十世时，
那么他就是一名真正的演员，能够放弃自己的身份，呈现他人的
外貌和个性。

source_text: Color acts in a similar way. Because of the after-image
translated_text: 色彩以类似的方式行动。由于后像

source_text:
(the simultaneous contrast), colors influence and change each other
forth and back. They continuously interact-in our perception.
translated_text:
（同时对比），色彩前后相互影响并彼此改变。
它们在我们的知觉中持续地相互作用。

source_text:
Value:
The word as such, when unspecified, permits application in innumerable
directions. By itself, it does not reveal on what level, in what direction
or field evaluation is meant.
translated_text:
价值：
这个词本身在未加限定时，允许被应用于无数
方向。它本身并不显示所指的评价位于什么层面、
朝向什么方向或属于什么领域。

source_text:
In color, it is a distinct measure only in connection with the Munsell
System. There, Munsell defines value as the lightness of a color. In
connection with other systems it has no outspoken meaning. The French
translated_text:
在色彩中，只有在与孟塞尔体系相关联时，它才是一种明确的尺度。
在那里，孟塞尔把价值定义为一种颜色的明度。在
与其他体系相关联时，它没有明示的意义。法语

source_text:
word valeur has a broader meaning. Unfortunately, the careless use of
"value," particularly with regard to equal lightness-as well as false
examples reproduced in books-has destroyed it as a means of measure.
Therefore we use "light intensity" instead as a self-explanatory term.
translated_text:
词 valeur 具有更广泛的意义。不幸的是，
“value”一词的随意使用，尤其是在涉及相等明度时——以及书中复制的错误
示例——已经破坏了它作为衡量手段的作用。
因此，我们改用“光强度”这个不言自明的术语。

source_text: (See Chapters v, page 12, and xxm, page 62.)
translated_text: （见第v章，第12页，以及第xxm章，第62页。）

source_text: Variants versus variety
translated_text: 变体与多样性

source_text:
The word "variety," although recently a favored design term,
has become discredited because of increased abuse. It has
become a pretentious recommendation for designs of questionable merit.
It is applied to protect hurried changes, to excuse poor alterations,
or to defend any accidental and meaningless whim. It even appears
as a weapon to prevent rejection, to force credits. Thus the excuse
translated_text:
“多样性”这个词，尽管近来是一个受到青睐的设计术语，
却因日益严重的滥用而名誉受损。它已成为对可疑价值设计的
自命不凡的推荐语。它被用来保护仓促的变化，
为拙劣的改动开脱，或为任何偶然且毫无意义的一时兴起辩护。
它甚至作为一种防止否决、强行取得学分的武器出现。因此，这种借口

source_text: "for variety's sake" remains a warning signal.
translated_text: “为变化而变化”仍然是一个警示信号。

source_text:
To replace this negative criterion, we are in favor of a related word
of better reputation, the design term "variant." As variety usually
concerns changes of details, variant means a more thorough re-doing of
a whole or of a part within a given scheme. Although variant may remind us
slightly of imitative plagiarism, normally it results from a
translated_text: 为了取代这一否定性标准，我们赞成使用一个相关而名声较好的词，即设计术语“变体”。正如“变化”通常涉及细节的改变，“变体”则意味着在既定方案内，对整体或某一部分进行更彻底的重做。尽管“变体”可能会使我们略微联想到模仿性的剽窃，但通常它源于

source_text:
thorough study. Because of a more comprehensive comparison
forth and back, it usually aims at a new presentation. On the whole,
variants demonstrate, besides a sincere attitude, a healthy belief
that there is no final solution in form; thus form demands unending
performance and invites constant reconsideration-visually as well as verbally.
translated_text: 深入的研究。由于在来回往复中进行了更全面的比较，它通常旨在形成一种新的呈现。总体而言，变体除了显示出一种真诚的态度之外，还表明一种健康的信念：形式不存在最终解决方案；因此，形式要求无止境的实践，并召唤不断的重新思考——既在视觉上，也在语言上。

source_text:
In lieu of a bibliography-
my first collaborators
translated_text:
代替书目——
我的第一批合作者

source_text: XXVI
translated_text: XXVI

source_text:
This book presents results of search, not of what is academically called
research.
As it is not a compilation from books, it does not end with a list of
translated_text:
本书呈现的是探寻的成果，而不是学术上所谓研究的成果。
由于它并非由书籍汇编而成，因此它并不以一份

source_text: books-either books read, or books not read.
translated_text: 书目作为结尾——无论是读过的书，还是未读过的书。

source_text:
Instead, this book ends with an acknowledgment of my students who are the
authors of the sample studies, and whom I therefore consider my indirect but
first collaborators.
translated_text: 相反，本书以对我的学生的致谢作为结尾；他们是样例研究的作者，因此我把他们视为我的间接的、却也是最初的合作者。

source_text:
In addition to the dedication of this book, I should like to state
that my students in color have taught me more color than have books
about color.
translated_text: 除本书的献辞之外，我还想说明：我的色彩课学生教给我的色彩知识，比关于色彩的书籍教给我的更多。

source_text:
Many students of this color course (which has been developed in the United States)
not only have found solutions of their own to known problems, but also
have visualized and discovered new problems, new solutions, and new
presentations. Although rarely shown, and therefore barely known so far,
their contributions deserve publication in the interest of a new
intensified training of eyes and minds-in both art education and
general education.
translated_text: 这门色彩课程（在美国发展起来）的许多学生，不仅为已知问题找到了自己的解决方案，而且还把新的问题、新的解决方案和新的呈现方式视觉化并发现出来。尽管这些贡献很少被展示，因而迄今几乎不为人知，但为了在艺术教育和普通教育中对眼睛与心智进行新的强化训练，它们值得发表。

source_text:
Those contributions come from 2 sides, from a majority of normally
gifted students, as well as from the minority of more gifted students.
And particularly this majority has taught me how to proceed, how to
open eyes and minds; even more important, it has taught me
what not to do.
translated_text: 这些贡献来自两个方面：既来自占多数的、具有正常天赋的学生，也来自少数更有天赋的学生。尤其是这个多数群体，教会了我如何推进，如何开启眼睛与心智；更重要的是，他们教会了我不该做什么。

source_text:
We should have liked to name here the authors of all the sample studies
reproduced in the first edition. Unfortunately, many names are lacking,
uncertain, or lost. The known names are listed alphabetically in the original
edition, followed by the numbers of the folders containing their studies.
translated_text: 我们本想在此列出第一版中所复制的全部样例研究的作者姓名。遗憾的是，许多姓名缺失、不确定或已经遗失。已知的姓名在原版中按字母顺序列出，其后附有包含其研究的文件夹编号。

A color has many faces, and 1 color can be made to appear as 2 different
colors. In the original design for the study 1v-1, horizontal dark blue and yellow stripes
were on a flap which could be lifted to show that a vertical stripe of ochre
is the same color at the top as at the bottom.
translated_text:
1v-1
一种颜色有许多面貌，而且一种颜色可以被做成看起来像两种不同的颜色。在研究 1v-1 的原始设计中，水平的深蓝色和黄色条纹位于一个可掀起的翻页上；掀起后可以看到，一条垂直的赭色条纹在上端和下端是同一种颜色。

source_text: Here it is almost unbelievable that the upper small and the lower
translated_text: 在这里，几乎令人难以相信，上方的小方块和下方的

small squares are part of the same paper strip and therefore are the

source_text:
Gradation studies
CHAPTER V
translated_text:
渐变研究
第五章

source_text:
v-1
The gradation in plate v-1 is a collage of small snippets of greys
carefully collected from magazine illustrations, which should come
from the same publications to ensure the same hue of the black.
translated_text:
v-1
图版 v-1 中的渐变，是由从杂志插图中仔细收集来的灰色小片拼贴而成；这些小片应来自同一出版物，以确保黑色具有相同的色相。

source_text:
They are arranged downward in the softest possible transition from
deep black to clear white, and then mounted as 4 equal-sized
rectangles on a cardboard sheet of a correct middle grey so that they
appear as in a window frame with a central cross, of which all parts
are the same width.
translated_text: 它们以尽可能柔和的过渡向下排列，从深黑到清晰的白色，然后作为 4 个大小相等的矩形，装裱在一张正确中灰色的卡纸上，使其看起来像带有中央十字的窗框，且所有部分宽度相同。

source_text:
This combination of decreasing blacks into clear whites within an
unchanging framework results in the following interaction: the 3
verticals of the frame appear increasingly lighter toward the top, and
similarly darker toward the base.
translated_text: 这种在不变框架内由递减的黑色过渡到清晰白色的组合，产生了如下相互作用：框架的 3 条竖线越往上显得越浅，同样，越往底部显得越深。

source_text:
Of the 3 horizontals within that frame the upper appears lighter, and
the lowest one darker. And the middle horizontal almost vanishes from
merging with its neighboring middle-grey snippets.
translated_text: 在该框架内的 3 条横线中，上面一条显得较浅，最下面一条显得较深。而中间那条横线由于与邻近的中灰色小片融合，几乎消失。

source_text:
Although such study depends very much on precision and patience,
similar studies should be encouraged. It should be mentioned that
samples of a real middle grey are hardest to find.
translated_text: 尽管这样的研究非常依赖精确和耐心，仍应鼓励开展类似研究。需要指出的是，真正中灰色的样本最难找到。

v-2

against the ground of a black-white gradation, are

这 2 则广告各自展示了一个香水瓶，背景为黑白渐变；其上分别部分贴覆了 1 条和 3 条竖带，这些竖带呈现出第二种渐变，与背景相反。
但这种第二种渐变只存在于我们的知觉之中。
事实上，这些竖带仅仅由
完全均匀的中灰色构成，它通过一种光的错觉而变得无法辨认。

in the same amount and the same shape. As stated before,

The choice of the bluest blue, marked by its vertical and

Disagreement must be expected with the 8 reds. Surely both reds at the left
will get votes of first choice, the first one probably
from older, and the second one from younger voters. The second,

source_text:
Reversed grounds
CHAPTER VI
translated_text:
反转的背景
第六章

source_text:
v1-3
Hold the plate with the yellow rectangle on the left. We see here
translated_text:
v1-3
将带有黄色矩形的图版置于左侧。我们在这里看到

source_text: 2 rectangles of 2 different colors connected as a pair.
translated_text: 2 个不同颜色的矩形相连成一对。

source_text: Within the pairs are 2 X-like forms which look different.
translated_text: 在这些成对形中，有 2 个看起来不同的 X 状形。

source_text: The longer we observe the X's, and the more we compare them
translated_text: 我们观察这些 X 的时间越长，并且越多地比较它们

source_text:
(best at some distance), the more we see that each
repeats the color of the opposite, neighboring ground.
We perceive the whole (both studies together) in 2 colors
of which each appears 2 times, namely as ground and as figure.
translated_text:
（最好在一定距离之外），就越会看到每一个都重复了对面相邻背景的颜色。
我们把整体（两个研究合在一起）知觉为 2 种颜色，其中每一种都出现 2 次，即一次作为背景，一次作为图形。

source_text: We do not see
translated_text: 我们看不到

source_text:
that the whole consists of more than 2 colors, and that the X's
are alike-meaning of one and the same color-
and therefore different from the colors of both grounds.
translated_text: 整体由不止 2 种颜色构成，而 X 是相同的——即同一种颜色——因此不同于两块底色的颜色。

source_text:
Consequently, we do not see that the
study consists not of 2 colors, but of 3.
translated_text: 因此，我们并未看出这项习作不是由 2 种颜色构成，而是由 3 种颜色构成。

source_text:
This is made visible
only through the small horizontal connection between the X's.
translated_text: 只有通过 X 之间那一小段水平连接，这一点才变得可见。

source_text:
This demonstrates
a discrepancy between factual colors of the X's and
the visual perception of these colors. In other words, we do not see
what these colors physically are.
translated_text: 这表明 X 的实际颜色与这些颜色的视觉感知之间存在差异。换言之，我们并未看见这些颜色在物理上究竟是什么。

source_text:
We study this
first, not as a surprising or entertaining illusion but to make
eyes and mind aware of the wonders of color interaction; second,
translated_text: 我们研究这一点，首先并不是把它当作一种令人惊奇或有趣的错觉，而是为了使眼睛和心智意识到色彩相互作用的奇妙；其次，

source_text: to learn to utilize color deception in creative color performance.
translated_text: 是为了学会在创造性的色彩表现中利用色彩欺骗。

source_text:
The problem is:
Find that color which on 2 different grounds loses its identity.
The question is:
What color relatedness makes 3 colors look like 2?
translated_text:
问题是：
找出那种颜色，它在 2 种不同底色上会失去自身的同一性。
提问是：
怎样的色彩关联会使 3 种颜色看起来像 2 种？

source_text:
VI-4
3 colors appear as 2 .
translated_text:
VI-4
3 种颜色显现为 2 种。

source_text:
On brown and violet grounds, the center squares look like
the grounds exchanged, violet and brown. But they are of the
same color, precisely alike, and at the same time refer to
the neighboring grounds. The true color of the 2
central squares therefore becomes unrecognizable, as it loses
translated_text: 在棕色和紫色底色上，中央方块看起来像是互换了的底色，即紫色和棕色。但它们属于同一种颜色，完全相同，同时又指向相邻的底色。因此，这 2 个中央方块的真实颜色变得无法辨认，因为它失去了

source_text: its identity.
translated_text: 自身的同一性。

source_text: go
translated_text: go

source_text:
v1-4
The semicircular forms appear as different colors above and below,
and these refer to the reciprocal grounds.
translated_text:
v1-4
半圆形在上方和下方显现为不同的颜色，而这些颜色指向相互对应的底色。

source_text: The visible connection between the 2 groups
translated_text: 这 2 组之间可见的连接

source_text: reveals that they are of the same color, therefore alike.
translated_text: 揭示出它们属于同一种颜色，因此是相同的。

source_text:
Question: Which color produces such deception?
And notice how the half-rings lead us to compare them with
"the other side." This study therefore presents an example of
"psychological engineering."
translated_text:
问题：哪一种颜色会产生这种欺骗？
并请注意这些半环如何引导我们把它们与“另一边”相比较。因此，这项习作呈现了一个“心理工程”的例子。

source_text:
Subtraction of color
CHAPTER VII
translated_text:
色彩的减除
第七章

source_text:
A new task: 2 different colors are to look alike,
or 4 colors are to look like 3, as explained on page 20 of the Text.
We consider this color change as color subtraction.
translated_text: 一项新的任务：使 2 种不同颜色看起来相同，或使 4 种颜色看起来像 3 种，正如《正文》第 20 页所说明的那样。我们把这种色彩变化视为色彩减除。

source_text: In order to present these unusual and little-known effects appropriately,
translated_text: 为了恰当地呈现这些不寻常且鲜为人知的效果，

source_text:
first cover the 2 colors in the margins or peripheries of the studies.
Then compare the centered small rectangles and find out
how equal or how similar they look.
translated_text: 先遮住这些习作边缘或外围的 2 种颜色。然后比较居中的小矩形，弄清它们看起来有多么相等或多么相似。

source_text:
For the best simultaneous comparison do not look from one center to
the other but focus firmly on a point in the middle between them,
which will be within the boundary of the grounds.
translated_text: 为了获得最佳的同时比较效果，不要从一个中心看向另一个中心，而要坚定地注视它们之间正中的一点，这一点将在底色的边界范围之内。

source_text:
Now, after the likeness or similarity has been recognized in the centers,
uncover the small color blocks in the margins (noted above), and see
what they really are. These 2 colors were the point of departure
for the study.
translated_text: 现在，在中心处的相似或近似被辨认出来之后，揭开边缘处的小色块（如上所述），看看它们究竟是什么。这两种颜色正是本研究的出发点。

source_text:
VII-2
A solution in heavy color.
translated_text:
VII-2
以浓重色彩作出的解答。

source_text:
vu-4
Hold plate v11-4 with the deep green ground on the left, and the light
grey ground on the right.
translated_text:
vu-4
将图版 v11-4 拿好，使深绿色底色在左，浅灰色底色在右。

source_text:
Below them are 2 contiguous horizontal stripes, the upper one a
brownish-green on top of a thin ochreous yellow.
translated_text: 在它们下方有两条相接的水平条纹，上面一条是带褐色的绿色，叠在一条细的赭黄色之上。

source_text: The small rectangles in the centers of the large rectangles seem to
translated_text: 大矩形中心处的小矩形似乎

source_text: be alike.
translated_text: 是相同的。

source_text:
vu-5
We see 1 pair of larger upright rectangles and 2 pairs of smaller
horizontal rectangles, each pair connected along a vertical axis.
The 2 upper pairs carry narrow stripes, on the larger as diagonals,
and on the smaller connected in a central horizontal axis.
translated_text:
vu-5
我们看到一对较大的竖向矩形和两对较小的横向矩形，每一对都沿一条垂直轴相连。上方两对带有窄条纹，在较大的矩形上表现为对角线，在较小的矩形上则沿中央水平轴相连。

source_text:
As to color, the deep red and yellowish off-white grounds at top
are reversed in the second pair. The quite different lower pair
contains a clear contrast, Naples yellow and ochre.
translated_text: 就色彩而言，顶部的深红色底色和带黄色的灰白色底色，在第二对中被互换。下方那一对则相当不同，包含一种明确的对比：那不勒斯黄与赭色。

source_text:
When comparing the 2 diagonals simultaneously, that is, not in sequence
but focusing on the middle between them, they will appear
very similar or even alike. But they are precisely
the same as the horizontal stripes beneath them, and
therefore factually as different as the colors at the bottom,
which are ochre and Naples yellow.
translated_text: 当同时比较这两条对角线时，也就是说，不是依次观看，而是注视它们之间的中间位置，它们会显得非常相似，甚至相同。但它们与其下方的水平条纹完全相同，因此事实上也像底部的颜色一样不同，即赭色与那不勒斯黄。

source_text:
Reading the study in the opposite direction-upward-the quite different
Naples yellow and ochre, when seen reversed on the contrasting grounds
of the middle pair, appear even more different. But when shown
in the same order on the reversed colors of the upper grounds,
they change from a distinct contrast to a pair of similar colors.
Naples yellow and ochre are changed to look alike.
translated_text: 若从相反方向——向上——阅读这项研究，颇为不同的那不勒斯黄和赭色，在中间那一对的对比底色上以互换方式呈现时，显得更加不同。但是，当它们以相同顺序呈现在上方底色的互换颜色上时，它们便从一种鲜明对比变成一对相似的颜色。那不勒斯黄和赭色被改变得看起来相同。

source_text:
VII-7
Hold the plate with the 3 small rectangles at the right.
translated_text:
VII-7
将图版拿好，使三个小矩形在右侧。

source_text:
This study shows a very courageous solution to the problem
because it makes a very light grey and a dark, almost black-grey
appear alike.
translated_text: 这项研究显示了对该问题一种非常大胆的解答，因为它使一种很浅的灰色和一种深的、几乎近于黑灰的颜色显得相同。

source_text:
Of the 3 small rectangles, the 2 lighter ones (above each other)
are exactly alike, and look exactly alike since they are seen
on the same ground, white.
translated_text: 在三个小矩形中，两个较浅的（上下排列）完全相同，而且看起来也完全相同，因为它们处在同一底色——白色——之上。

source_text:
The third small and connected rectangle-because of its darkness-
appears in color similar or equal to the large dark ground
at the left. Thus, it seems unbelievable that the small dark one
is precisely repeated in the center of the dark ground where it
looks much lighter-unbelievably lighter.
translated_text: 第三个较小且相连的矩形——由于其深暗——在色彩上显得与左侧的大块深色底色相似或相等。因此，令人难以置信的是，这个小的深色矩形在深色底色的中心被精确地重复，在那里它看起来却浅得多——浅得令人难以置信。

source_text:
Now, having next to each other dark on darker and light on lighter-
the left and right center as horizontal neighbors
in parallel optical conditions (equal placement, shape, and
quantity relationship )-we are able to compare them. If this is done
properly, which means simultaneously (not alternatingly,
as explained before), we will perceive that the white-grey
and the black-grey, seen first as connected contrasts, appear alike.
Q. E. D., what was to be proved.
translated_text: 现在，深色置于更深色之上，浅色置于更浅色之上，二者彼此相邻——左右两个中心作为水平相邻者，处于平行的光学条件中（位置、形状和数量关系相等）——我们便能够比较它们。如果这一比较进行得当，也就是同时进行（不是交替进行，如前所述），我们将会觉察到，最初作为相连对比而被看到的白灰色和黑灰色，显得相同。Q. E. D.，即所要证明者。

source_text:
For a visual proof, make a flap by tracing the 2 dark-grey rectangles
on a sheet of paper from your school notebook
translated_text: 为了作视觉证明，可在一张学校笔记本纸上描摹这两个深灰色矩形，做成一个翻片

source_text:
(usually slightly translucent), cut them out, somewhat smaller,
and compare what you see through these openings.
translated_text: （这种纸通常略微半透明），把它们剪下来，剪得稍小一些，然后比较你透过这些开口所看到的东西。

source_text: After-image
translated_text: 后像

source_text: CHAPTER VIII
translated_text: 第八章

source_text:
vm-1
Turn the page so that the red circle is on the left.
translated_text:
vm-1
翻转页面，使红色圆形位于左侧。

source_text:
If we stare for half a minute at the red circle, focusing continually
on the marked center, and then focus on the white center,
we do not see white. The color we see there
is the after-image of red and is a simultaneous contrast.
translated_text: 如果我们凝视红色圆形半分钟，始终聚焦于标出的中心，然后再聚焦于白色中心，我们看到的并不是白色。我们在那里看到的颜色是红色的后像，也是一种同时对比。

source_text:
v11r-2
For a clear understanding of interaction of color caused by
interdependence of color we should experience what "after-image"
means. Before going on to study plate vr11-2 complete the exercise
described on page 22.
translated_text:
v11r-2
要清楚理解由颜色相互依存所造成的颜色相互作用，我们应当体验“后像”是什么意思。在继续研究图版 vr11-2 之前，请完成第22页所述的练习。

source_text:
Now hold the plate with the white square on the right. On the left are yellow
circles of equal diameter which touch each other and fill out a white
square. There is a black dot in its center. On the right is an empty
white square, also with a centered black dot. Each is on a black ground.
After staring for half a minute at the left square, shift the focus suddenly
to the right square.
translated_text: 现在手持图版，使白色正方形位于右侧。左侧是直径相等的黄色圆形，它们彼此相接并填满一个白色正方形。其中心有一个黑点。右侧是一个空白的白色正方形，同样有一个居中的黑点。两者都位于黑色底上。凝视左侧正方形半分钟后，突然将焦点移至右侧正方形。

source_text:
Here one experiences a very different after-image. Instead of seeing the
complement of the yellow circles (blue), diamond shapes are seen-
the leftover shapes of the circles-in yellow. This illusion is a double
and thus reversed after-image, sometimes called contrast reversal.
translated_text: 在这里，人们会体验到一种非常不同的后像。看到的不是黄色圆形的补色（蓝色），而是黄色的菱形——圆形之间留下的形状。这种错觉是一种双重的、因而反转的后像，有时称为对比反转。

translated_text: IOfi

source_text:
Color mixture in paper
CHAPTER IX
translated_text:
纸上的颜色混合
第九章

source_text:
IX-1
In painting it is easy to mix pigments by pouring them together and
stirring them, which achieves an in-between color as a mixture. Since
translated_text:
IX-1
在绘画中，通过把颜料倒在一起并加以搅拌来混合颜料很容易，这会得到一种作为混合物的中间色。由于

source_text:
this is not possible with paper, we must imagine a possible "in-between
color." In plate 1x-1 we superimpose part ofa brown rectangle on a
rosy-red rectangle. First we pass our eyes from left to right several times
across the overlapping area, in which the mixture should appear.
translated_text: 这在纸上无法做到，我们必须想象一种可能的“中间色”。在图版 1x-1 中，我们把一个棕色矩形的一部分叠加在一个玫瑰红色矩形上。首先，我们让视线从左到右数次掠过重叠区域，混合色应当在那里出现。

source_text:
After several passages back and forth we see that the red appears to
come through the brown at the left, and the brown seems to come
through the red at the right border of the overlap. This is proof that
we have a true mixture.
translated_text: 来回数次之后，我们看到红色似乎在左侧透过棕色显现出来，而在重叠部分的右边界，棕色似乎透过红色显现出来。这证明我们得到了一种真正的混合。

source_text:
It is easy to see that the right edge of the brown rectangle has a heavier
boundary than the left edge of the red. Therefore this mixture
contains more brown than red. Thus, the brown is on top; in other
words, the brown is dominant in the mixture.
translated_text: 很容易看出，棕色矩形的右边缘比红色矩形的左边缘有更重的边界。因此，这种混合中棕色多于红色。于是，棕色在上；换言之，棕色在混合中占主导。

source_text:
Now try to find a mixture in which the red is on top and therefore
dominant.
translated_text: 现在试着找出一种红色在上、因而占主导的混合。

source_text:
Read Chapter XI and find some color mixture in paper that produces
various space illusions.
translated_text: 阅读第十一章，并找出一些纸上的颜色混合，它们会产生各种空间错觉。

source_text:
1x-3
Even texture effects submit to the illusion of transparence.
translated_text:
1x-3
即使是肌理效果也会服从透明感的错觉。

source_text:
(1.) A saturated middle blue and a typical chocolate brown are
overlapped by the same beige-like tone decorated with simulated
leather texture. Within the overlappings appear illusionary
mixtures of a tint of blue and of brown, and with these an
translated_text: （1.）一种饱和的中蓝色和一种典型的巧克力棕色，被同一种类似米色的色调所重叠，该色调饰有模拟皮革肌理。在重叠处出现了蓝色淡调和棕色淡调的错觉性混合，并随之产生一种

source_text:
illusion of transparence. We also see the textural leather
decor carried over, making the transparence still more convincing.
We are easily reminded of those thin, light, dyed, and inexpensive
translated_text: 透明感错觉。我们还看到皮革肌理装饰被延续过去，使透明感更加令人信服。我们很容易联想到那些薄的、轻的、染色的、廉价的

source_text: plastics which are made to cover lightweight luggage.
translated_text: 塑料，它们被用来覆盖轻便行李箱。

source_text:
(r.) A rectangle of newspaper chosen for its texture of letters
(which we call typofacture) is overlapped by (or overlapping?)
a square of an even deep yellow. Here the overlapping shows
illusions of mixture and transparence. It also preserves the
precise size, type, and spacing of the letters.
translated_text: （r.）一块因其字母肌理（我们称之为字形肌理）而被选用的报纸矩形，被一个均匀的深黄色正方形所重叠（或正在重叠它？）。这里的重叠显示出混合和透明感的错觉。它还保留了字母精确的大小、字体和间距。

source_text:
The question is: How is the illusion of transparence
or translucence achieved?
A second question: How would it be possible to achieve
a transparence illusion in which the newspaper appears on
top of the yellow paper?
translated_text:
问题是：透明或半透明的错觉是如何实现的？
第二个问题：怎样才可能实现一种透明感错觉，使报纸看起来位于黄色纸张之上？

source_text: Additive and subtractive mixture
translated_text: 加色混合与减色混合

source_text: CHAPTER X
translated_text: 第十章

source_text:
x-1
Hold plate x-1 with the dark background on the left.
translated_text:
x-1
将图版 x-1 置于左侧有深色背景的位置。

source_text:
Obviously both studies are based on the same underlying design
of 3 overlapping rectangles, providing a common subdivision of area.
translated_text: 显然，两项研究都基于同一基本设计，即 3 个相互重叠的矩形，从而提供了共同的面积划分。

source_text:
The 3 rectangles are of equal shape and size,
and hinged in their combined left corners. They are, furthermore,
related as tints of the same color, namely a grey-violet.
translated_text: 这 3 个矩形形状和大小相同，并在它们合并后的左角处铰接。此外，它们彼此相关，都是同一颜色的不同浅色调，即一种灰紫色。

source_text:
With regard to light, the 2 groups of rectangles move
in opposite directions. At left, from a dark ground to a light center,
at right from a light ground to a dark center.
translated_text: 就明度而言，这两组矩形朝相反方向变化。左侧从深色底面变化到浅色中心，右侧从浅色底面变化到深色中心。

source_text:
On both sides, each of the 3 rectangles overlaps the 2 others
only once. By looking transparent (in fact, they are opaque)
they produce in our perception illusions of mixture, in 3 steps
of either light or shade-a gradual increase in light at the left
but a decrease in light at the right.
translated_text: 在两侧，3 个矩形中的每一个都只与另外 2 个矩形各重叠一次。由于它们看起来透明（事实上是不透明的），便在我们的感知中产生了混合的错觉，形成明或暗的 3 个步骤——左侧是光的逐渐增加，而右侧则是光的减少。

source_text:
With their contrasting results of gaining and of losing light,
these studies explain a basic difference in mixture,
that is, mixture in direct color-which is light-and its opposite,
mixture in reflected color-produced by pigment.
translated_text: 这些研究以其获得光与失去光的相反结果，说明了混合中的一个基本差异，即直接色——也就是光——中的混合，以及它的反面，由颜料产生的反射色中的混合。

source_text:
The first, the product of a mixture by a physicist,
by combining light (direct color) results in addition of light.
Whereas the second, a combining of pigments (indirect, reflected color)
and done by the colorist, results in subtraction of light.
translated_text: 前者是物理学家通过混合光（直接色）所得的产物，其结果是光的增加。而后者是由色彩家完成的颜料混合（间接的、反射的颜色），其结果是光的减少。

source_text:
Now, since both studies are done in pigments (inks),
they "present," in fact, reflected light only;
they also "represent," in illusion only,
at right, subtractive mixture, the area of the painter,
and at left, additive mixture, the realm of the physicist.
translated_text: 现在，由于两项研究都是用颜料（油墨）完成的，它们事实上只“呈现”反射光；同时，它们也仅以错觉“再现”：右侧为减色混合，属于画家的领域；左侧为加色混合，属于物理学家的领域。

source_text:
Transparence and space-illusion
CHAPTER XI
translated_text:
透明性与空间错觉
第十一章

source_text:
x1-1
This deserves recognition as an unusually precise study
translated_text:
x1-1
这应被视为一项异常精确的研究

source_text:
Optical mixture
CHAPTER XII
translated_text:
光学混合
第十二章

source_text:
In contrast to after-image, here is another very different color illusion,
"optical mixture." 2 or more colors perceived simultaneously appear
combined as a third actual color, a mixture which annuls and replaces
the previous factual colors. (See Text, page 33.)
translated_text:
与后像相反，这里是另一种十分不同的色彩幻觉，
“光学混合”。同时被感知的2种或更多颜色显得
合并为第三种实际颜色，这种混合抵消并取代了
先前的事实颜色。（见正文，第33页。）

source_text:
xn-2
Turn the page so that the white dots are at the right.
translated_text:
xn-2
将页面转动，使白点位于右侧。

source_text:
The size of the circular elements in blue, green, and white demands
observation from a distance. At right, compare the lightest whites
with the empty and filled whites, then with the smaller whites
at the left.
Looking from the left, compare all the blues-those with and without ground
in the middle, those with green and with white centers,
and those appearing as centers of green and white. In the middle
see and compare similarly the greens and their changes
through optical mixture.
See the whole also in a vertical position when more than
3 colors seem to appear in varying spatial positions.
translated_text:
蓝色、绿色和白色圆形元素的大小要求
从一定距离进行观察。在右侧，将最浅的白色
同空白和填充的白色比较，再同左侧较小的白色
比较。
从左侧看，比较所有蓝色——中间有底色
和没有底色的蓝色，有绿色和白色中心的蓝色，
以及作为绿色和白色中心出现的蓝色。在中间，
同样观察并比较绿色及其通过光学混合产生的变化。
也以垂直位置观看整体，此时似乎会有超过
3种颜色出现在不同的空间位置中。

source_text:
The Bezold Effect
CHAPTER XIII
translated_text:
贝佐尔德效应
第十三章

source_text:
XIII-I
The French Impressionists (after 1870) aimed at an optical mixture
translated_text:
XIII-I
法国印象派画家（1870年以后）追求一种光学混合

source_text:
effect. Instead of mixing their colors on their palettes, they applied
them in small dabs on the canvas so that the colors were mixed, at a
distance, in our eyes.
translated_text: 效果。他们不是在调色板上混合颜色，而是把这些颜色以小点涂在画布上，使颜色在一定距离外，在我们的眼中完成混合。

source_text:
A similar effect is named after Wilhelm von Bezold (1837-1907), a
meteorologist in Berlin, who discovered that certain strong colors, when
evenly distributed, changed entirely the effect of his rug designs, which
were his avocation.*
translated_text: 一种类似的效果以威廉·冯·贝佐尔德（1837—1907）的名字命名。他是柏林的一位气象学家，发现某些强烈的颜色在均匀分布时，会完全改变他地毯图案设计的效果；地毯设计是他的业余爱好。*

source_text:
One of my color students, following Bezold 's example, showed in plate
xm-1 light red bricks laid up with very white mortar, and then showed
the same bricks laid up with pure black mortar. The red with the white
looks much lighter than the red with the black, particularly at a distance.
translated_text: 我的一位色彩课学生仿效贝佐尔德，在图版 xm-1 中展示了用非常白的灰浆砌起的浅红色砖块，随后又展示了同样的砖块用纯黑灰浆砌起的效果。配以白色时的红色看起来比配以黑色时的红色要浅得多，尤其是在远处观看时。

source_text:
*The Theory of Color and Its Relation to Art and Art Industry, trans.,
Boston, Prang, 1876.
translated_text: *《色彩理论及其与艺术和艺术工业的关系》，译本，波士顿，普朗，1876年。

source_text:
XIII-2
The change of 1 color alters both light and weight of
the original, and, one can say, its speed and age as well.
translated_text:
XIII-2
一种颜色的改变，会改变原物的明度和重量，而且也可以说，会改变它的速度和年代感。

source_text:
Another reading: besides the Bezold Effect, its opposite
appears here-an after-image effect-when the dark red flanking
the black is compared with the same red accompanying
the white. Define this change.
translated_text: 另一种解读：除贝佐尔德效应之外，这里还出现了它的相反现象——一种后像效应——当把黑色两侧的暗红色与伴随白色的同一种红色相比较时便会显现。请界定这一变化。

source_text:
xm-3
This commercial decorative design for a printed textile (of questionable merit) is
the point of departure for proving the Bezold Effect.
It shows the original condition in the upper part.
translated_text:
xm-3
这件用于印花织物的商业装饰设计（其优劣值得怀疑）是证明贝佐尔德效应的出发点。
它在上部显示了原始状态。

source_text:
Substituting white for the black, it lights up
all other colors, which is the aim of the Bezold Effect
translated_text: 以白色替代黑色，会使所有其他颜色变亮，这正是贝佐尔德效应的目的

source_text: and of this study.
translated_text: 也是本研究的目的。

source_text:
Color intervals and transformation
CHAPTER XIV
translated_text:
色彩间隔与转换
第十四章

source_text:
XIV-I
A "transformation" of 4 reds to 4 blues of a slightly lower key seems
comparable to a transformation of a tetrachord in music from 1
instrument to another. Therefore we are also in color concerned with
"intervals." But such rearrangement is far more complicated with
colors than with musical notes.
translated_text:
XIV-I
将4种红色“转换”为4种调子稍低的蓝色，似乎可与音乐中将一个四音列从一种乐器转换到另一种乐器相比较。因此，在色彩中我们同样涉及“间隔”。但这种重新安排在色彩中远比在音符中复杂。

source_text:
Upstairs in plate XIV-I we have 4 red squares at the left, making I
square, and 4 blue squares at the right, also making a square. Each has
its darkest squares on the left. In the top row of each the strongest
contrast exists between the left and right squares, and they are separated
by the hardest boundaries.
translated_text: 在图版 XIV-I 的上方，左侧有4个红色正方形，组成1个正方形；右侧有4个蓝色正方形，也组成一个正方形。两者最暗的正方形都在左侧。在各自的顶行中，最强的对比存在于左、右两个正方形之间，并且它们由最坚硬的边界分隔。

source_text:
To demonstrate whether they provide the same "intervals," downstairs
we transfer the blue square arrangement to the center of the reds,
and vice versa. After this transformation, if the intervals are correct,
translated_text: 为了证明它们是否提供相同的“间隔”，在下方，我们把蓝色正方形的排列转移到红色的中央，反之亦然。经过这种转换之后，如果间隔是正确的，

source_text:
the hardest boundary in the top pairs of squares is repeated in the
upper halves of the vertical axis, and the lower pairs show the evenly
softer boundaries.
translated_text: 顶端成对正方形中最坚硬的边界，就会在垂直轴线的上半部重复出现，而下方成对的正方形则显示出均匀而较柔和的边界。

source_text:
In order to train your eyes, compare the corresponding boundaries
upstairs and downstairs, from left to right. Then you will see that in all
four cases the left vertical halves are heavier and that the right
vertical halves are foggy. Read Chapter XIV and look at the 6 drawings
that illustrate it.
translated_text: 为了训练你的眼睛，请从左到右比较上方和下方相应的边界。然后你会看到，在所有四种情形中，左侧的垂直半部都较重，而右侧的垂直半部则显得雾蒙蒙。请阅读第十四章，并观看说明该章的6幅图。

source_text: A tetrachord of 4juxtaposed reds (2 shades+ 2 tints)
translated_text: 一个由 4 个并置的红色（2 个暗度 + 2 个淡度）构成的四音列

source_text:

into 3 other hues-to 2 deeper keys of blue (left) and grey (center),
and to a higher key of orange (right).
For a comparison of the intervals of the 4 tones within all 4 hues,
the transformations are placed, in reduced size, in the centers

and thus as a common measure.
Although the blues may appear lighter than the surrounding reds,
translated_text:
以 3 次相等的重复呈现。随后，这 4 个红色被转化为另外 3 种色相——转化为两个更深调子的蓝色（左）和灰色（中），以及一个更高调子的橙色（右）。
为了比较全部 4 种色相中 4 个色调的间隔，这些转化形以缩小的尺寸置于 3 个重复的红色并置的中心；这些红色并置现在作为底色，从而成为共同的度量。
虽然这些蓝色看起来可能比周围的红色更亮，

source_text:

and also in warm and in cool artificial light.
translated_text: 但事实上，在漫射日光（室内和室外）、充足阳光下，以及在暖色和冷色人工光下，它们都比相邻的红色更暗。

Here, 4 colors different in hue and in light are changed into

Intersection
CHAPTER XV
translated_text:
交叉
第十五章

source_text:
xv-1
Hold plates xv-1 so that the yellow and green rectangles are on the left.
Cut off the flap so that you have a separate sheet that is printed on both sides,
with single and double dots keying the proper color to each study.
This sheet we place so close to the right boundary of the first color
at the left that only a small strip of the second color (about¼" wide)
remains visible.
While staring at this small strip, move the loose sheet
slowly to the right, and thus reveal more and more of the
second color, the central color. When this is done a new illusion occurs:
The central color looks more and more like 2 colors, repeating
at the left boundary the color of the right neighbor, at the right the color
of the left neighbor.
This study works best in incandescent (warm) artificial light.
To accustom oneself to the phenomenon,
the exercise should be shown repeatedly.
translated_text:
XV-1
持图版 XV-1，使黄色和绿色矩形位于左侧。
剪下折页，使你得到一张单独的、双面印刷的纸页，纸页上以单点和双点标明各项习作对应的正确颜色。
我们将这张纸页放得非常靠近左侧第一种颜色的右边界，以致第二种颜色只剩下一条很窄的条带（约 1/4 英寸宽）可见。
凝视这条窄条带时，将这张活动纸页缓慢向右移动，由此逐渐显露出越来越多的第二种颜色，即中央颜色。这样做时，会出现一种新的错觉：中央颜色越来越像 2 种颜色，在左边界处重复右侧邻色的颜色，在右侧处重复左侧邻色的颜色。
这项习作在白炽（暖色）人工光下效果最佳。
为了使自己习惯这一现象，
应反复展示这个练习。

When staring at the center of the study, immediately
the central color will appear as 2 colors, repeating
at the left contour the color of the field at right, and at the

(To demonstrate this in 3 dimensions, intersect the straight fingers

This new kind of transparence proves a new measure for such mixtures.

这种新的透明性为这类混合提供了一种新的度量。经过一番观察之后，混合中是否包含 2 个混合母色的相等或不相等的量，就会变得显而易见。
这里，中央色场在日光下以及暖色加冷色荧光灯下看起来是均匀混合的。但在暖色白炽灯下，

especially at some distance, the pink dominates by far

that the separating boundaries of a middle mixture look elevated,

Quantity
CHAPTER XVI
translated_text:
量
第十六章

source_text:
This is a new kind of exercise, exploring how changes of quantity in color
can change appearance and influence of color.
translated_text: 这是一种新的练习，探究色彩在数量上的变化如何改变色彩的外观和影响。

source_text:
xv1-1
View all 4 studies simultaneously, so that the stripes appear vertical.
They show a first approach to a solution of the problem ( described on
page 43 of the Text). Here the 4 grounds are the largest areas
occupied alternatingly by each of the 4 colors.
Each color then carries the 3 other colors as figure,
in stripes of very different placements, and each, through connection
or separation, appears in wide or narrow, loose or tight groupings.
translated_text:
xv1-1
同时观看全部4项研究，使条纹呈垂直状。它们显示了对一个问题的解决方案的初步尝试（见《正文》第43页所述）。这里，4个底是由4种颜色各自交替占据的最大面积。随后，每一种颜色又承载另外3种颜色作为图形，以位置极为不同的条纹呈现；并且每一种颜色都通过连接或分离，显现为宽或窄、松散或紧密的组合。

source_text: Although the pink appears somewhat dominant (which can be justified),
translated_text: 尽管粉红色显得略占主导（这是可以说明其理由的），

source_text:
the 4 panels are of 4 different characters.
This will be more obvious when we look at them as walls,
much wider than high, by covering (simplest by hand)
the upper two-thirds of each panel. First, consider yourself
confronting each wall, and then, seeing others against these walls.
translated_text: 这4块画面具有4种不同的性格。当我们把它们看作墙面时，这一点会更加明显：这些墙面的宽度远大于高度，可用遮盖（最简单的是用手）每块画面上方三分之二的方式来观看。首先，设想你自己面对每一面墙；然后，设想看到其他人处在这些墙前。

source_text: Select your favorite studies, and find the reason for your preference
translated_text: 选出你最喜欢的研究，并找出你偏好的原因

source_text:
(but also for your rejections). And learn that your preferences

translated_text: （也要找出你排斥它们的原因）。并且要认识到，你的偏好不会是一成不变的，而会随着时间和你自身状况而改变，就像偏见一样。

source_text:
See that such systematic studies go beyond self-expression
and avoid self-disclosure. Instead, they lead us to comparison,
and so to evaluation, and further to self-criticism
and self-education.
translated_text: 要看到，这类系统研究超越了自我表现，并避免了自我暴露。相反，它们引导我们进行比较，从而进行评价，并进一步走向自我批评和自我教育。

source_text:
Please do not ask which is the "best" design,
although we have seen this question printed, because,
without further qualification as to cause and purpose,
translated_text: 请不要问哪一个是“最佳”设计，尽管我们曾见过这个问题被印出来，因为如果不对原因和目的作进一步限定，

source_text:
this question is both unjustified and irrelevant.
It merely discloses the incompetence of the inquirer.
translated_text: 这个问题既没有正当性，也无关紧要。它只不过暴露了提问者的无能。

source_text: (See comments on variants and variety, page 73 of the Text.)

source_text:
xv1-3
An unusual solution. Besides its representation in 4 circles
and its subordination under a severe restriction-that is,
a precisely repeated subdivision of the 4 circles-it demonstrates
clearly the extreme cases of connection and separation within and
among circles: The inner centrifugal enclosure
-cohesion-against the outer centrifugal enclosure
-adhesion.
translated_text:
xv1-3
一种不同寻常的解决方案。除了以4个圆来呈现，并从属于一种严格限制——即4个圆的分割被精确重复——之外，它还清楚地展示了圆内以及圆与圆之间连接与分离的极端情形：内在的离心围合——内聚——与外在的离心围合——黏附——相对。

source_text:
xv1-3
A most successful "quantity study," and an amazing

一项极为成功的“数量研究”，并且是对最初倾向于采用

This reminds us of varnish applied first on 3 of 5

source_text:
Free studies
CHAPTER XVIII
translated_text:
自由习作
第十八章

source_text:
These studies are to prove that a systematic step-by-step learning
through obligatory class problems does not handicap personal development.
The repeatedly expressed expectation that a concentration on obligatory
class problems disturbs individual talents and interests
has been proved wrong.
translated_text:
这些习作旨在证明，通过规定的课堂课题进行系统的循序渐进学习，
并不会妨碍个人发展。
人们一再表示的那种预期，即专注于规定的
课堂课题会干扰个人天赋和兴趣，
已经被证明是错误的。

source_text:
As correct grammar and proper spelling must not obstruct poetic creation,
so clear observation and clean articulation must not lead to a domineering
school fashion or style,
nor to an obedient and imitative discipleship.
translated_text:
正如正确的语法和规范的拼写不应阻碍诗歌创作一样，
清晰的观察和干净的表达也不应导致一种占支配地位的
学院风尚或风格，
也不应导致顺从而模仿性的门徒关系。

这些自由习作提供的是对差异的研究：态度、
步骤和目的上的差异；媒介的亲和与对比方面的差异；
以及它们在应用上的差异。它们促使人辨别保持不变的或变化中的
节奏、步调和速度；拓扑方向，如向内和向外、
横向、垂直或居中的运动；
已获得的、被避免的和被忽视的效果。等等。

source_text: xvn1-1 An interesting activation is demonstrated here. Whereas
translated_text: XVIII-1 这里展示了一种有趣的激活。虽然

source_text:
a strictly repeated pattern never is read through-
from beginning to end, that is-here a continued modification
produces a near-pattern design inviting us to a
comprehensive "looking through."
translated_text:
一个严格重复的图案从来不会被通读——
也就是说，从开端读到结尾——但在这里，一种连续的变形
产生了一种近乎图案的设计，邀请我们进行
全面的“透视”。

source_text: XVIII-2 In our color course we do not teach composition or related rules
translated_text: XVIII-2 在我们的色彩课程中，我们不教授构图或相关规则

source_text:
to be followed or applied. We also avoid speaking of "color
design" in pictorial use of color.
translated_text:
供人遵循或应用。在绘画性的色彩使用中，
我们也避免谈论“色彩设计”。

source_text:
We prefer to make comparisons between pictorial organization
and cooking, for instance, because of its measuring of amount
and flavor and its continuous tasting. Or we find parallels
with conducting, because of its coordination of emphasis and
subordination, and because of its rehearsing before performance.
In our free studies we aim at a visually challenging
interplay of influencing and influenced colors-in other words,
a presentation of active relatedness.
translated_text:
我们更愿意把绘画组织同烹饪相比较，
例如，因为烹饪要衡量分量
和味道，并且要不断品尝。或者，我们也会发现它
与指挥之间的相似之处，因为指挥要协调强调与
从属，并且要在演出前排练。
在我们的自由习作中，我们追求的是一种在视觉上富于挑战性的
相互作用：影响他物的色彩与受到影响的色彩之间的相互作用——换言之，
一种主动关联性的呈现。

source_text:
Here 1 distinctive shape dominates. Many circles of equal size
are tightly connected in horizontal-vertical rows.
Thus they present a mechanical and easy distribution,
extending over the entire space, leaving in-between spaces
of only 1 shape and size.
The only freedom left, it seems, is a choice of color and light.
translated_text:
这里有1种独特形状占据主导。许多大小相同的圆
以水平—垂直的行列紧密相连。
因此，它们呈现出一种机械而容易的分布，
延展到整个空间，只留下
形状和大小都只有1种的间隙空间。
似乎留下的唯一自由，就是对色彩和明度的选择。

source_text: We recommend such organization of "restricted means,"
translated_text: 我们推荐这种“受限制的手段”的组织方式，

source_text:
because a limitation in 1 direction often opens more
freedom in other directions.
For another restriction (not in form, as here), we suggest
"a restricted palette"-a limitation to a few colors,
or to 1 hue only, to 2-voiced instead of multi-voiced, and especially
to monochromatic juxtaposition.
translated_text:
因为在1个方向上的限制，往往会在其他方向上开启更多
自由。
对于另一种限制（不像这里这样是在形式上），我们建议
“受限制的调色板”——限制为少数几种颜色，
或仅限于1种色相，限制为双声部而非多声部，尤其是
限制为单色并置。

source_text: xvm-3 A typical but successful assemblage in color paper. Quite free
translated_text: xvm-3 彩色纸中一个典型而成功的组合。相当不受

source_text:
of color harmony, each color manages to "save its own face."
Although loosely lined up, through a distinct relationship of
translated_text:
色彩和谐的约束，每一种颜色都设法“保全自己的面子”。
尽管排列松散，但通过外部形状与内部特征之间一种明确的关系，

source_text:
the outer shapes and the inner features, it is held in a firm unity
and an equilibrium of independence and
dependence.
translated_text: 它被维系在牢固的统一之中，并保持着独立与依存的平衡。

source_text: xv111-3 A double interaction between 2 dimmed tones of red and green
translated_text: xv111-3 红与绿两种减暗色调之间的双重相互作用

source_text:
combines 2 contrasting effects, an after-image with its opposite,
an optical mixture.
translated_text:
结合了两种相反的效果：一种是带有其对立面的后像，
一种是视觉混合。

source_text:
Whereas the more frequent and even subdivision
of the outer areas tends toward a greyed-down optical mixture,
the after-image occurs in the elliptical center, where
the green ground-after a figure-ground exchange-shows
a larger broadening than the reds.
The numerical reduction of stripes in the center consequently
produces a clear increase in both light and color for the green,
but a gain only in color, with a loss in light, for the red.
translated_text:
外部区域较为频繁且均匀的细分趋向于一种灰化的视觉混合，
而后像则发生在椭圆形的中心，在那里，
绿色底面——经过一次图形—底面互换之后——显示出
比红色更大的扩展。
因此，中心条纹数量的减少
使绿色在明度和色彩两方面都明显增强，
但对于红色而言，只在色彩上有所增加，而明度则有所损失。

source_text:
All of this results in a subtle change in posture,
from an outer soft flatness to a central emphasis of direction.
And both are reversed by a strong figure-ground change
translated_text:
这一切造成了姿态上的微妙变化，
从外部柔和的平面性，转向中心对方向性的强调。
而这二者又都被一条穿过水平中心线的强烈图形—底面变化所反转

source_text: through the horizontal center line.
XVIII-g An arrangement of stripes of very contrasting character.
translated_text: XVIII-g 一种性格反差很大的条纹安排。

source_text:
These can be read (from bottom to top) first, as warm and soft
against hard and cool; second, with relation to interiors,
translated_text:
这些条纹可以（从下到上）首先被解读为温暖而柔软
对抗坚硬而冷峻；其次，若联系室内空间，

source_text:
as a heavy carpet against a light papered wall; and third,
if considered as sounds, as woodwinds against brass.
translated_text:
可解读为厚重的地毯对抗轻盈的裱纸墙面；第三，
若将其视为声音，则可解读为木管对抗铜管。

source_text:
In addition, there is a harmonious and sonorous assemblage
of adjacent colors which makes the blues look warm.
All these differences can be read
despite the fact that all the colors appear in the shape
of stripes, stripes which are all equally
"hard-edged."
translated_text:
此外，还有一种由相邻色构成的和谐而洪亮的组合，
使蓝色看起来显得温暖。
尽管所有颜色都呈现为条纹的形状，
而且这些条纹全都同样是
“硬边”的，
所有这些差异仍然可以被读出。

source_text:
xv111-11
Once or twice during a color course we limit the independence we have
for free studies. Then, in order to get closely related studies
which invite an intensified comparison, the whole class submits
to a given combination of 3 or 4 colors in paper. They are
selected by students or teachers, or are chosen as a restricted palette
from a challenging study by a class member.
translated_text:
xv111-11
在色彩课程中，我们有一两次会限制自由习作所拥有的独立性。于是，为了获得彼此关系密切、
促使比较加强的习作，整个班级都会服从于纸上给定的三种或四种颜色组合。它们由学生或教师选定，或从班上一位成员具有挑战性的习作中
选取为一个受限制的调色板。

source_text:
Such studies of equal instrumentation not only will remind us
of our inclinations and aversions for certain colors, but will
help to clarify where and when our choice and neglect appear
justified and when not.
translated_text:
这种同等配器的习作，不仅会提醒我们
自己对某些颜色的偏好与厌恶，而且会
帮助澄清我们的选择与忽略在何处、何时显得
有道理，又在何时并非如此。

source_text:
Notice that this study includes
the white of the ground as active color.
translated_text: 请注意，这件习作把底面的白色也作为主动的颜色包括在内。

source_text:
The Masters
CHAPTER XIX
translated_text:
大师们
第十九章

source_text:
x1x-1
(I.) This study is not a copy in the usual understanding of a replica.
(See Text, page 53.) As Van Gogh copied Daumier, for instance,
translated_text:
x1x-1
（I.）这件习作并不是通常所理解的复制品意义上的临摹。
（见正文，第53页。）例如，正如梵高临摹杜米埃，

source_text:
and Cezanne copied Italian masters, in a free personal manner and mainly
to clarify one or another particular viewpoint, so this transformation
into color paper is not a repetitious duplication. It purposely neglects
many details and even may appear in changed keys of light and temperature.
translated_text:
塞尚临摹意大利大师，都是以自由的个人方式，并主要为了阐明某个特定观点一样，
这种向彩色纸的转换并不是重复性的复制。它有意忽略许多细节，
甚至可能以改变了的明度和温度调性出现。

source_text:
It is a consciously condensed record of a personal notation
of a painting's color instrumentation, or, in usual terms,
of its palette and color relatedness.
translated_text:
它是对一幅绘画的色彩配器的个人记述所作的有意识的凝缩记录，
或者按通常说法，
是对其调色板和色彩关联性的记录。

source_text:
(r.) The unavoidable flattening of the 4-color process with its loss of opacity
and plasticity of the paints in the original unfortunately
shows its leveling effects here, by losing the directness,
freshness, and solidity of the pasted paper colors
and their tactile edges.
translated_text:
（r.）四色制版不可避免的扁平化，以及它对原作中颜料不透明性
和造型感的损失，不幸地在这里显示出其拉平的效果：它丧失了
粘贴纸色彩的直接性、
新鲜感和坚实性，
以及它们可触知的边缘。

source_text:
It should be easy to distinguish here the study in paper from its
"reproduced original." This study is based on a work by Matisse.
translated_text:
在这里，应当很容易把纸上习作同它的
“复制出来的原作”区分开来。这件习作基于马蒂斯的一件作品。

source_text:
The Weber-Fechner Law
CHAPTER XX
translated_text:
韦伯—费希纳定律
第二十章

source_text: xx-1 4 equal rectangles of the same color,
translated_text: xx-1 4个颜色相同的等大矩形，

source_text:
a translucent yellow, overlap each other in a systematic order which
produces 4 different yellows separated by 3 different kinds
of boundaries.
translated_text: 一种半透明的黄色，以有系统的次序彼此重叠，从而产生4种不同的黄色，并由3种不同类型的边界加以分隔。

source_text:
Only the central square consists of 4 layers of yellow.
Surrounding it there are 4 squares consisting of 3 layers,
then 8 shapes of 2 layers, and around them all-8 shapes of 1 layer only.
translated_text: 只有中央的正方形由4层黄色构成。其周围有4个由3层构成的正方形，再往外是8个2层的形状，而环绕它们全部的，则是8个仅有1层的形状。

source_text: For a precise recognition, locate each group of squares singly.
translated_text: 为求精确认识，应逐一确定每一组正方形的位置。

source_text:
For a reading in an opposite direction, differentiate:
all outer shapes show only 1 layer of yellow, therefore are lightest.
These 8 shapes, through continued corner connections, present 8 pairs.
Each pair surrounds, alternatingly with 2 or 3 edges,
translated_text: 若从相反方向阅读，则要区分：所有外部形状只显示1层黄色，因此最浅。这8个形状，通过连续的角部连接，呈现为8对。每一对以2条或3条边交替地围绕着

source_text:
1 double, 5 single, and I quarter square, all of 2 layers of yellow
which naturally are darker than I layer of yellow.
translated_text: 1个双正方形、5个单正方形和1个四分之一正方形，它们全都具有2层黄色，自然比1层黄色更暗。

source_text:
Similarly, all shapes of 2 layers are connected again as a ring
-to 8 pairs-or to 4 trios-embracing 4 squares of 3 layers of yellow.
These latter 4 squares of 3 layers
enclose entirely (through both corner and edge connections)
the center square which alone has 4 layers, and therefore is darkest,
and has the softest, almost vanishing boundaries.
translated_text: 同样，所有2层的形状又连接成一个环——成为8对，或成为4组三联形——环抱着4个具有3层黄色的正方形。后者这4个3层的正方形（通过角部连接和边部连接）完全围住中央正方形；唯有中央正方形具有4层，因此最暗，并且边界最柔和，几乎消失。

source_text:
This heaping of translucent yellow on white paper in I to 4 layers
presents (physically) gradual mixtures in an arithmetical progression.
But in our perception the gradual reduction of light within the yellows,
as well as the gradual softening of the boundaries between them,
is of a geometric proportion.
translated_text: 这种在白纸上叠加半透明黄色、由1层至4层的方式，（在物理上）呈现出按算术级数递进的逐渐混合。但在我们的知觉中，黄色内部光亮的逐渐减弱，以及它们之间边界的逐渐柔化，则呈几何比例。

source_text:
Both reductions-or increases, when read the opposite way-
demonstrate the Weber-Fechner Law (see Text, page 54).
translated_text: 这两种减弱——若从相反方向阅读，则为增强——都证明了韦伯—费希纳定律（见正文，第54页）。

source_text:
It is easy to conclude that an additional fifth layer
would hardly increase the darkening of the yellow,
nor would it mark further boundary separation.
translated_text: 很容易得出结论：再增加第五层，几乎不会增强黄色的变暗，也不会进一步标示出边界的分离。

source_text:
xx-1
2 gradation scales for a comparison of arithmetical and
geometric progression in mixture of color (here red and black).
Both are to be read downward, thus beginning with red.
translated_text:
xx-1
2个渐变标尺，用于比较颜色混合（此处为红色与黑色）中的算术级数和几何级数。二者都应向下阅读，因此均从红色开始。

source_text:
(I.) To the upper red is mixed successively 1 - 2 - 3 - 4
equal amounts of black, as has been recommended by
translated_text: （左）在上方的红色中依次混入1—2—3—4等量的黑色，正如

source_text:
M. E. Chevreul (see Text, page 54) and which presents
an arithmetical progression, but only physically,
not perceptually.

Vibrating boundaries
CHAPTER XXII

XXII-1
2 contrasting or near-contrasting colors are arranged

to produce an effect of vibrating boundaries (see Text, page 61).
In case you wear glasses, look at the studies with and without them,
and, if possible, in near and far focus.
Distinguish also where the doubling of the contour occurs,
outside or inside of the figures.
Observe them also in daylight and in different artificial lights.

Notice that these studies are done in regular color paper,
not in so-called "day-glow" paper. Whereas the effect of the

here the vibration effect appears
as an illusion for which we have no known explanation.
XXII-2 Turn the page so the green center square is on the left.

2 studies of precisely the same arrangement,
but with reversed colors. That the vibrating

For another reading of such illusionary vibration, one can

Equal light intensity
CHAPTER XXIII

xx111-1
2 tints, ochre and pink, are purposely shown

in aggressive shapes, indicating 2 two-edged saws.
At left they are separated, except for point connections.
But when fully connected, as at right, and when seen

at left, almost disappear in a smooth merging of the

2 different colors. The reason for this loss of form

(See Text, page 62.)
xxnr-2 Here is a figure extending sideward and

with many sharp corners. Although all shapes
are similar triangles, clearly constructed-with pointed
corners and straight lines-we cannot be sure in the top figure

And it is not possible to count all the triangles, much less

Color theories
CHAPTER XXIV
xx1v-1 The Equilateral Triangle

It is probably the most condensed and clear system of presentation of
an essential order in the vast world of color.
Within the 2 dimensions of an equilateral triangle-subdivided
in g similar triangles-are 3 primaries, 3 secondaries, and
(unexpectedly) 3 tertiaries, all placed very sensibly.

The first of the 3 trios, containing the strongest color contrasts,
appears most separated, at the extreme ends-in the 3 corners.
Yellow and blue (which Goethe called "the only 2 pure colors," and

also "the primeval contrast") appropriately hold the base.
And red ("the middle between them") occurs high off at the apex,
again separated but in a middle place.
The less opposite secondaries are in the middle of the
outer edges, and the closest, or least different, tertiaries
naturally meet still more in the center.

The drawings on page 66 of the Text show 3 more groupings
which invite further study of relationships within the groups

and also among the groups.
We suggest copying the g groupings on tracing paper

( on top of the equilateral triangle) and cutting
them as stencils for further comparisons.

Josef Albers, one of the most influential artist-educators of the twentieth
century, was a member of the Bauhaus in Germany during the 1920s. In

1933 he came to the United States, where he taught at Black Mountain
College for sixteen years. In 1950 he joined the faculty at Yale University

as chairman of the Department of Design; after his retirement in 1958 he
was named emeritus professor of art, a position he held until his death
in 1976. The recipient of numerous awards and honorary degrees, Albers
was elected to the National Institute of Arts and Letters in 1968 and in

1971 was the first living artist ever to be given a solo retrospective at The
Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York.

Nicholas Fox Weber is executive director of the Josef and Anni Albers
